source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν διδάσκοντος αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εὐαγγελιζομένου ἐπέστησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς σὺν τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις, καὶ εἶπαν λέγοντες πρὸς αὐτόν· Εἰπὸν ἡμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, ἢ τίς ἐστιν ὁ δούς σοι τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην;

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass on one of the days, teaching him the people in the temple and proclaiming the good news, came up the chief priests and the scribes with the elders, \v 2 and they spoke saying to him, Tell us by what authority these things you do, or who is the [one] having given to you the authority this?

en.L: And it happened on one of the days, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching the people in the temple and proclaiming the good news, [that] the chief priests and the scribes with the elders came up, \v 2 and they spoke, saying to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Tell us by what authority {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are doing these things, or who is the one who gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} this authority?"
en.B: One day, as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple and telling them the good news, the chief priests and the scribes came up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, together with the elders. \v 2 "Tell us," they said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "what authority do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have to do these things? Who is it that gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} this authority?"
en.R: One day Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and telling them the good news. The chief priests and the teachers of the law came up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and the elders came with them. \v 2 They said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Tell us what authority {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have to do these things. Who gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} this authority?"

es.L: Y sucedió en uno de los días, mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enseñaba al pueblo en el templo y anunciaba la buena noticia, [que] se presentaron los jefes de los sacerdotes y los escribas con los ancianos, \v 2 y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hablaron, diciendo: «Dinos: ¿con qué autoridad haces estas cosas, o quién es el que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dio esta autoridad?».
es.B: Un día, mientras Jesús enseñaba al pueblo en el templo y le anunciaba la buena noticia, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los escribas, junto con los ancianos, se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron. \v 2 «Dinos», {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron, «¿con qué autoridad haces estas cosas? ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dio esta autoridad?».
es.R: Un día Jesús estaba enseñando a la gente en los patios del templo y le anunciaba la buena noticia. Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los maestros de la ley se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron, y los ancianos vinieron con ellos. \v 2 Le dijeron: «Dinos qué autoridad tienes para hacer estas cosas. ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dio esta autoridad?».

fr.L: Et il arriva, un de ces jours, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait le peuple dans le temple et annonçait la bonne nouvelle, [que] les chefs des prêtres et les scribes, avec les anciens, survinrent, \v 2 et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parlèrent, disant : « Dis-nous par quelle autorité {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais ces choses, ou qui est celui qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a donné cette autorité ? »
fr.B: Un jour, comme Jésus enseignait le peuple dans la cour du temple et lui annonçait la bonne nouvelle, les chefs des prêtres et les scribes vinrent {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouver, avec les anciens. \v 2 « Dis-nous, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent-ils, de quelle autorité disposes-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pour faire cela ? Qui est celui qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a donné cette autorité ? »
fr.R: Un jour, Jésus enseignait le peuple dans la cour du temple et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui annonçait la bonne nouvelle. Les chefs des prêtres et les spécialistes de la Loi sont venus vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et les anciens sont venus avec eux. \v 2 Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Dis-nous quelle autorité {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as pour faire ces choses. Qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a donné cette autorité ? »

sw.L: Ikawa siku moja, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alipokuwa akiwafundisha watu hekaluni na kuhubiri habari njema, wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi pamoja na wazee walimjia, \v 2 wakamwambia, wakisema, "Tuambie ni kwa mamlaka gani unafanya mambo haya, au ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya?"
sw.B: Siku moja Yesu alipokuwa akiwafundisha watu hekaluni na kuwahubiria habari njema, wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi walimjia pamoja na wazee. \v 2 Wakamwambia, "Tuambie, una mamlaka gani ya kufanya mambo haya? Ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya?"
sw.R: Siku moja Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha watu katika nyua za hekalu na kuwahubiria habari njema. Wakuu wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walimjia, na wazee walikuja pamoja nao. \v 2 Wakamwambia, "Tuambie una mamlaka gani ya kufanya mambo haya. Ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya?"

vi.L: Và xảy ra vào một trong những ngày ấy, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang dạy dỗ dân chúng trong đền thờ và rao giảng Tin Lành, thì các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo cùng với các trưởng lão đến, \v 2 và nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Hãy nói cho chúng tôi biết, ông làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào, hay ai là người đã ban cho ông thẩm quyền này?"
vi.B: Một hôm, khi Đức Giê-xu đang dạy dỗ dân chúng trong sân đền thờ và rao giảng Tin Lành cho họ, các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo cùng với các trưởng lão đến gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 2 Họ chất vấn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Hãy cho chúng tôi biết, ông lấy thẩm quyền nào mà làm những việc này? Ai đã ban cho ông thẩm quyền ấy?"
vi.R: Một hôm, Đức Giê-xu đang dạy dỗ dân chúng trong sân đền thờ và rao giảng Tin Lành cho họ. Các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy dạy luật đến gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cùng với các trưởng lão. \v 2 Họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Hãy cho chúng tôi biết ông có quyền gì mà làm những việc này. Ai đã cho ông quyền ấy?"

decisions.choice: the chief priests, the scribes and the elders: the groups that made up the ruling council in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The senior priests, the experts in the law and the leading laymen formed the council. Jesus had named these same three groups as the ones who would reject him (9:22), and they were already looking for a way to destroy him (19:47).

decisions.choice: authority: the right to act, given by someone with the power to give it
decisions.reason: Their second question shows what they mean: who gave him the right? Teachers were expected to have been trained and approved, and the temple was under the priests' control.

decisions.choice: these things: what Jesus has been doing in the temple
decisions.reason: He had entered the city as king, driven the traders out of the temple and taught there every day (19:37-48). The leaders ask by whose authority he does all this.

decisions.choice: proclaiming the good news: announcing God's saving rule
decisions.reason: The verb is the one Luke uses for Jesus' preaching of the kingdom of God (4:43; 8:1).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: the temple courts; the chief priests; the teachers of the law
alternatives: the temple; the chief priests; the scribes
decisions.reason: Readable says that Jesus taught in the courts around the temple, as at 19:47. As in 19:47: "scribes" today suggests people who copy documents, so Readable says what these men did.

decisions.choice: los escribas (L, B); los maestros de la ley (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering, recorded once in this file: "escribas" is the established Spanish word for these experts in the law (meaning decision m1); Readable says what they did, as the English Readable does. The same in verses 19, 39 and 46.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on separate pronouns and on pronouns before the verb (él, le, te)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Spanish usually leaves the subject pronoun out and can join an object pronoun to the end of the verb ("hacerle", "entregarlo"), where there is nothing separate to capitalise. So the setting covers fewer words than in English; this holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); historic presents kept as presents at Literal; the parable of 20:9-16 and the Sadducees' case of 20:29-32 in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: passé simple for the parable at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: As in Luke 19 and Mark 11-12: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level, including the stories told inside it. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: le temple (L), la cour du temple (B, R); les chefs des prêtres; les scribes (L, B), les spécialistes de la Loi (R); les anciens (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, as in Luke 19:45-47 and Mark 11: Jesus taught in the open courts (m1 of 19:45), so Balanced says so as Readable does; "les grands prêtres" would blur the line with "le grand prêtre" himself; Readable follows the English "teachers of the law".

decisions.choice: waandishi (L, B); walimu wa sheria (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering, recorded once in this file: "waandishi" is the established Swahili word for these experts in the law (meaning decision m1); Readable says what they did, as the English Readable does. The same in verses 19, 39 and 46.

decisions.choice: mamlaka
decisions.reason: Authority is the right to act, given by someone with the power to give it (meaning decision m2). "Mamlaka" is the book-wide word; "haki" is kept for righteousness, and "uwezo" is ability rather than a right. The same in verses 8 and 20.

decisions.choice: "ông" for the leaders addressing Jesus, with no deity_pronoun span (also 20:5)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:28: the leaders speak to Jesus as to any man, without the respect of a disciple; the word is theirs, so the reader's setting does not capitalise it.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" (L), "sân đền thờ" (B, R); "rao giảng Tin Lành"; "các thầy tế lễ cả", "các thầy thông giáo" (L, B) / "các thầy dạy luật" (R), "các trưởng lão"
decisions.reason: The forms of the Vietnamese Mark 11-13, used through this chapter; "Tin Lành" at every level, Readable included.

decisions.choice: "thẩm quyền" (L, B); "quyền" (R) (also 20:8)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:28.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον, καὶ εἴπατέ μοι·

records.literal_gloss: Answering then he said to them, Will ask you I also a word, and tell me:

en.L: And answering, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "I also will ask you a question, and you tell {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}:
en.B: He answered them, "I too will ask you a question. Tell {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} this:
en.R: Jesus answered, "I will ask you a question too. You answer {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}:

es.L: Y respondiendo, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «También yo {{plural_you:les|os}} haré una pregunta, y {{plural_you:díganme|decidme}}:
es.B: Él les respondió: «Yo también {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a hacer una pregunta. {{plural_you:Díganme|Decidme}} esto:
es.R: Jesús les respondió: «Yo también {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a hacer una pregunta. {{plural_you:Respóndanme|Respondedme}}:

fr.L: Et, répondant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Moi aussi, je vous poserai une question ; et vous, dites-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} :
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Moi aussi, je vais vous poser une question. Dites-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ceci :
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Moi aussi, je vais vous poser une question. Répondez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} :

sw.L: Naye akajibu, akawaambia, "Pia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitawauliza swali, nanyi mniambie:
sw.B: Akawajibu, "Hata {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitawauliza swali. Niambieni hili:
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Pia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitawauliza swali. Nijibuni:

vi.L: Và đáp lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Ta cũng sẽ hỏi các người một câu, và hãy nói cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết:
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Ta cũng sẽ hỏi các người một câu. Hãy trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}:
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta cũng sẽ hỏi các người một câu. Các người hãy trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}:

decisions.choice: a word: a question, one matter
decisions.reason: The common word for word here means one point or question, as the next sentence shows.

decisions.choice: I also will ask you: a real answer, not a way of escape
decisions.reason: Teachers often answered a question with a question. Jesus' question holds the answer to theirs: if John was sent by God, then so was the one John said was coming (3:16), and the leaders had refused John (7:30).

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:4
decisions.reason: Jesus' question follows in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:les|os}}; {{plural_you:díganme|decidme}}
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to several people, so every plural "you" takes the reader setting: "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) or "vosotros" (Spain). English has no such choice, so these spans have no English counterpart. The same throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}; no span on akawaambia, mniambie
decisions.reason: As through Luke, Swahili spans go only on free pronouns and possessives, never on verb prefixes or object markers (akawaambia, mniambie), which cannot take a capital. Here the free "mimi" of Jesus's "I too" carries the setting, where the English "I" has none. So Swahili has fewer spans than English in this chapter, and a few the English lacks.

decisions.choice: "các người" for Jesus addressing the leaders (20:3-8)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:29.

source.text: Τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάννου ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἦν ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων;

records.literal_gloss: The baptism of John from heaven was it or from men?

en.L: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or from {{gender:people|men}}?"
en.B: John's baptism: did it come from heaven, or from {{gender:people|men}}?"
en.R: When John baptized people, was it God who sent him to do it? Or was it only a human idea?"

es.L: El bautismo de Juan, ¿era del cielo o {{gender:de los seres humanos|de los hombres}}?».
es.B: El bautismo de Juan, ¿vino del cielo o {{gender:de los seres humanos|de los hombres}}?».
es.R: Cuando Juan bautizaba a la gente, ¿fue Dios quien lo envió a hacerlo? ¿O fue solo una idea humana?».

fr.L: Le baptême de Jean, était-il du ciel ou des {{gender:humains|hommes}} ? »
fr.B: Le baptême de Jean : venait-il du ciel ou des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}} ? »
fr.R: Quand Jean baptisait les gens, est-ce Dieu qui l’avait envoyé faire cela ? Ou était-ce seulement une idée humaine ? »

sw.L: Ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?"
sw.B: Ubatizo wa Yohana: ulitoka mbinguni, au kwa wanadamu?"
sw.R: Yohana alipowabatiza watu, je, ni Mungu aliyemtuma kufanya hivyo? Au lilikuwa wazo la kibinadamu tu?"

vi.L: Phép báp-têm của Giăng là từ trời hay từ loài người?"
vi.B: Phép báp-têm của Giăng đến từ trời hay từ loài người?"
vi.R: Khi Giăng làm báp-têm cho người ta, có phải Đức Chúa Trời đã sai ông làm việc đó không? Hay đó chỉ là ý của loài người?"

decisions.choice: from heaven: from God
decisions.reason: Jews often said "heaven" instead of naming God, out of reverence (15:18, 21).

decisions.choice: the baptism of John: John's whole work of baptizing and calling people to repent
alternatives: only the act of baptizing in water
decisions.reason: John baptized people as a sign that they were turning back to God, and he announced one greater than himself (3:3, 16). The question is whether God sent him.

decisions.choice: from men: from human beings, a human idea
decisions.reason: The word is the general word for human beings, set against heaven, that is, God.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general (m3).

decisions.choice: was it God who sent him to do it? Or was it only a human idea?
alternatives: was it from heaven or from people?
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "from heaven" means (m1) and what the other choice would mean.

decisions.choice: wanadamu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "people" against "men". Swahili "wanadamu" (human beings) already includes everyone, and the only alternative, "wanaume", would mean males, so the setting has nothing to change. The same in verses 6, 18, 34 and 36.

decisions.choice: "loài người" with no gender span (also 20:6)
decisions.reason: "loài người" already means men and women, as in Mark 11:30, so the English gender setting has nothing to change.

source.text: οἱ δὲ συνελογίσαντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντες ὅτι Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ· Διὰ τί οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: And they reasoned among themselves saying that, If we say, From heaven, he will say, Why not did you believe him?

en.L: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say, 'Why did you not believe him?'
en.B: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we answer, 'From heaven,' {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will ask, 'Then why did you not believe him?'
en.R: They talked about it among themselves. They said, "If we say, 'God sent him,' Jesus will ask us, 'Then why did you not believe John?'

es.L: Y ellos razonaron entre sí, diciendo: «Si decimos: “Del cielo”, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dirá: “¿Por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?”.
es.B: Ellos lo discutieron entre sí y dijeron: «Si respondemos: “Del cielo”, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos preguntará: “Entonces, ¿por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?”.
es.R: Lo hablaron entre ellos. Dijeron: «Si decimos: “Dios lo envió”, Jesús nos preguntará: “Entonces, ¿por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}} a Juan?”.

fr.L: Et ils raisonnèrent entre eux, disant : « Si nous disons : “Du ciel”, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira : “Pourquoi ne l’avez-vous pas cru ?”
fr.B: Ils en discutèrent entre eux et se dirent : « Si nous répondons : “Du ciel”, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demandera : “Alors pourquoi ne l’avez-vous pas cru ?”
fr.R: Ils en ont parlé entre eux. Ils ont dit : « Si nous disons : “C’est Dieu qui l’a envoyé”, Jésus va nous demander : “Alors pourquoi n’avez-vous pas cru Jean ?”

sw.L: Nao wakajadiliana wao kwa wao, wakisema, "Tukisema, 'Kutoka mbinguni,' {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atasema, 'Kwa nini hamkumwamini?'
sw.B: Wakajadiliana wao kwa wao, wakasema, "Tukijibu, 'Ulitoka mbinguni,' {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atatuuliza, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini?'
sw.R: Walizungumza jambo hilo wao kwa wao. Wakasema, "Tukisema, 'Mungu ndiye aliyemtuma,' Yesu atatuuliza, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini Yohana?'

vi.L: Và họ bàn luận với nhau, nói rằng: "Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ trời,' thì ông ta sẽ nói: 'Tại sao các người không tin ông ấy?'
vi.B: Họ bàn với nhau: "Nếu chúng ta trả lời: 'Từ trời,' ông ta sẽ hỏi: 'Thế thì tại sao các người không tin ông ấy?'
vi.R: Họ bàn tính với nhau. Họ nói: "Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Đức Chúa Trời đã sai ông ấy,' thì ông ta sẽ hỏi chúng ta: 'Vậy sao các người không tin Giăng?'

decisions.choice: reasoned among themselves: talked it over together, weighing the possible answers
decisions.reason: The verb means to work something out together. They do not ask what is true, only which answer is safe. The tenants in the parable will reason among themselves in the same way (20:14).

decisions.choice: believe him: accept John's message as from God
decisions.reason: To believe John was to repent and to accept the one he said was coming. The Pharisees and experts in the law had refused his baptism (7:29-30).

decisions.choice: Jesus; John
decisions.reason: Readable names the two men, since "he" and "him" mean different people here.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:6; what Jesus would say is in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The leaders go on talking in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: "ông ta" for Jesus in the leaders' words, with no deity_pronoun span; Readable does not supply his name
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:31: the leaders speak of Jesus among themselves as "ông ta"; "ông ấy" and "Giăng" are John.

source.text: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, ὁ λαὸς ἅπας καταλιθάσει ἡμᾶς, πεπεισμένος γάρ ἐστιν Ἰωάννην προφήτην εἶναι·

records.literal_gloss: If but we say, From men, the people all will stone us, having been persuaded for it is John a prophet to be;

en.L: But if we say, 'From {{gender:people|men}},' all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet."
en.B: But if we answer, 'From {{gender:people|men}},' the whole crowd will stone us, because they are sure John was a prophet."
en.R: But if we say, 'It was only a human idea,' all the people will kill us by throwing stones at us. They are sure that John was a prophet."

es.L: Pero si decimos: “{{gender:De los seres humanos|De los hombres}}”, todo el pueblo nos apedreará, porque está convencido de que Juan era un profeta».
es.B: Pero si respondemos: “{{gender:De los seres humanos|De los hombres}}”, toda la gente nos apedreará, porque todos están seguros de que Juan era profeta».
es.R: Pero si decimos: “Fue solo una idea humana”, toda la gente nos matará a pedradas. Están seguros de que Juan era un profeta».

fr.L: Mais si nous disons : “Des {{gender:humains|hommes}}”, le peuple tout entier nous lapidera, car il est persuadé que Jean était un prophète. »
fr.B: Mais si nous répondons : “Des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}}”, toute la foule nous lapidera, car elle est sûre que Jean était un prophète. »
fr.R: Mais si nous disons : “C’était seulement une idée humaine”, tout le peuple va nous tuer en nous jetant des pierres. Les gens sont sûrs que Jean était un prophète. »

sw.L: Lakini tukisema, 'Kutoka kwa wanadamu,' watu wote watatupiga kwa mawe, kwa maana wanasadiki kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii."
sw.B: Lakini tukijibu, 'Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,' umati wote utatupiga mawe, kwa sababu wana hakika kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii."
sw.R: Lakini tukisema, 'Lilikuwa wazo la kibinadamu tu,' watu wote watatuua kwa kutupiga mawe. Wana hakika kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii."

vi.L: Còn nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ loài người,' thì cả dân chúng sẽ ném đá chúng ta, vì họ tin chắc rằng Giăng là một nhà tiên tri."
vi.B: Nhưng nếu chúng ta trả lời: 'Từ loài người,' thì cả dân chúng sẽ ném đá chúng ta, vì họ tin chắc Giăng là một nhà tiên tri."
vi.R: Nhưng nếu chúng ta nói: 'Đó chỉ là ý của loài người,' thì tất cả dân chúng sẽ ném đá giết chúng ta. Họ tin chắc rằng Giăng là một nhà tiên tri."

decisions.choice: will stone us: will kill us by throwing stones
alternatives: will throw stones to frighten us
decisions.reason: Stoning was the law's punishment for blasphemy and false prophecy (Leviticus 24:14-16; Deuteronomy 13:1-10), and an angry crowd might stone someone without a trial (Acts 7:58; John 10:31). To call a prophet of God a fraud would anger the people.

decisions.choice: having been persuaded: they hold a settled conviction
decisions.reason: The perfect tense describes a conviction already formed and still held.

decisions.choice: all the people: the crowds listening in the temple
decisions.reason: As in 19:48 and 20:1, the people who hang on Jesus' words. The leaders fear them again in 20:19.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: As in 20:4: human beings in general.

decisions.choice: It was only a human idea; kill us by throwing stones at us
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the wording of its 20:4 and explains what stoning was (m1).

source.text: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν μὴ εἰδέναι πόθεν.

records.literal_gloss: And they answered not to know from where.

en.L: And they answered that they did not know where [it was] from.
en.B: So they answered that they did not know where it came from.
en.R: So they answered that they did not know where John's baptism came from.

es.L: Y respondieron que no sabían de dónde [era].
es.B: Así que respondieron que no sabían de dónde venía.
es.R: Así que respondieron que no sabían de dónde venía el bautismo de Juan.

fr.L: Et ils répondirent qu’ils ne savaient pas d’où [il venait].
fr.B: Ils répondirent donc qu’ils ne savaient pas d’où il venait.
fr.R: Alors ils ont répondu qu’ils ne savaient pas d’où venait le baptême de Jean.

sw.L: Nao wakajibu kwamba hawajui [ulitoka] wapi.
sw.B: Basi wakajibu kwamba hawajui ulikotoka.
sw.R: Basi wakajibu kwamba hawajui ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka wapi.

vi.L: Và họ trả lời rằng không biết từ đâu.
vi.B: Vì vậy họ trả lời rằng họ không biết nó đến từ đâu.
vi.R: Vì thế họ trả lời rằng họ không biết phép báp-têm của Giăng đến từ đâu.

decisions.choice: they did not know: they chose not to say
decisions.reason: Luke has just shown their reasoning (20:5-6). Their answer protects them; it is not an honest judgment. Leaders who will not judge John's authority cannot ask about Jesus'.

decisions.choice: from where: where John's baptism came from
decisions.reason: The question was about John's baptism (20:4).

decisions.choice: John's baptism
decisions.reason: Readable says what "it" is (m2).

source.text: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

records.literal_gloss: And the Jesus said to them, Neither I tell you by what authority these things I do.

en.L: And Jesus said to them, "Neither do I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."
en.B: Jesus said to them, "Then I am not going to tell you either by what authority I do these things."
en.R: So Jesus said, "Then I will not tell you where {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} authority to do these things comes from either."

es.L: Y Jesús les dijo: «Tampoco yo {{plural_you:les|os}} digo con qué autoridad hago estas cosas».
es.B: Jesús les dijo: «Entonces yo tampoco {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a decir con qué autoridad hago estas cosas».
es.R: Entonces Jesús dijo: «Pues yo tampoco {{plural_you:les|os}} diré de dónde viene {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} autoridad para hacer estas cosas».

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « Moi non plus, je ne vous dis pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses. »
fr.B: Jésus leur dit : « Je ne vous dirai donc pas non plus par quelle autorité je fais cela. »
fr.R: Alors Jésus a dit : « Eh bien, je ne vous dirai pas non plus d’où vient {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autorité pour faire ces choses. »

sw.L: Naye Yesu akawaambia, "Wala {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} siwaambii ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya."
sw.B: Yesu akawaambia, "Basi hata {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Yesu akasema, "Basi {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia sitawaambia mamlaka {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya kufanya mambo haya yanatoka wapi."

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta cũng không nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Vậy thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy thẩm quyền nào mà làm những việc này."
vi.R: Vì vậy Đức Giê-xu nói: "Vậy thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không cho các người biết quyền làm những việc này của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ đâu mà đến."

decisions.choice: neither do I: as they would not answer, so he will not
decisions.reason: "Neither" matches their refusal. Jesus has kept his part of the bargain (20:3); they have not kept theirs.

decisions.choice: I do not tell you: Jesus leaves the answer in his question
alternatives: Jesus hides the source of his authority
decisions.reason: Anyone who accepted that God sent John could see who sent Jesus. The parable that follows answers the question in another way: he is the owner's son (20:13).

decisions.choice: where {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} authority comes from
decisions.reason: Readable rephrases the question as one about the source of his authority, which is what the leaders asked (20:2).

source.text: Ἤρξατο δὲ πρὸς τὸν λαὸν λέγειν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην· Ἄνθρωπος ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν χρόνους ἱκανούς.

records.literal_gloss: He began then to the people to speak the parable this: A man planted a vineyard, and leased it to farmers, and went abroad times long.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard and leased it to tenant farmers, and went abroad for a long time.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard and let it out to tenants. Then he went abroad and stayed away a long while.
en.R: Then Jesus told the people this story: "A man planted a vineyard, a field where grapes grow. He rented it to some farmers, who would take care of it for him. Then he went away to another country for a long time.

es.L: Entonces comenzó a contar al pueblo esta parábola: «Un hombre plantó una viña, y la arrendó a labradores, y se fue al extranjero por bastante tiempo.
es.B: Luego contó al pueblo esta parábola: «Un hombre plantó una viña y la dejó a cargo de unos arrendatarios. Después se fue a otro país y estuvo fuera mucho tiempo.
es.R: Luego Jesús le contó a la gente esta historia: «Un hombre plantó una viña, un campo donde se cultivan uvas. Se la alquiló a unos labradores, que la cuidarían por él. Luego se fue a otro país por mucho tiempo.

fr.L: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se mit à dire au peuple cette parabole : « Un homme a planté une vigne, l’a louée à des vignerons et est parti à l’étranger pour longtemps.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} raconta au peuple cette parabole : « Un homme a planté une vigne et l’a louée à des vignerons. Puis il est parti à l’étranger et il est resté longtemps absent.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus a raconté cette histoire au peuple : « Un homme a planté une vigne, un champ où pousse le raisin. Il l’a louée à des cultivateurs, qui devaient s’en occuper pour lui. Puis il est parti dans un autre pays pour longtemps.

sw.L: Kisha akaanza kuwaambia watu mfano huu: "Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu, akalikodisha kwa wakulima, akaenda ng'ambo kwa muda mrefu.
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia watu mfano huu: "Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu, akawakodishia wakulima. Kisha akaenda nchi nyingine, akakaa huko muda mrefu.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia watu mfano huu: "Mtu mmoja alipanda mizabibu katika shamba lake, yaani shamba ambamo zabibu hukua. Aliwakodishia wakulima fulani shamba hilo, ili walitunze kwa niaba yake. Kisha akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine kwa muda mrefu.

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu kể cho dân chúng ngụ ngôn này: "Một người trồng một vườn nho, cho các tá điền thuê, rồi đi xa một thời gian lâu.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kể cho dân chúng ngụ ngôn này: "Có một người trồng một vườn nho và cho các tá điền thuê. Rồi ông đi sang nước khác và ở đó lâu ngày.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu kể cho dân chúng câu chuyện này: "Có một người trồng một vườn nho, là một khu đất trồng nho. Ông cho mấy người nông dân thuê vườn nho để họ chăm sóc nó cho ông. Rồi ông đi sang một nước khác trong một thời gian dài.

decisions.choice: planted a vineyard: Isaiah's song of the vineyard, where the vineyard is Israel
alternatives: an ordinary farming story with no background
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 5:1-7 God plants a vineyard, cares for it, and finds only bad fruit; the vineyard is the house of Israel. Jesus' hearers in the temple would know the song. Here the trouble is not the vineyard but those put in charge of it.

decisions.choice: leased it to tenant farmers: they worked the land and paid the owner a share of the crop
decisions.reason: Owners who lived far away often let their land to tenants who paid rent in produce. The farmers here are tenants, not owners or day laborers.

decisions.choice: went abroad: left the country
decisions.reason: The verb means to go away from one's own country, as in 15:13 and 19:12.

decisions.choice: to the people: the parable is told to the crowd, with the leaders listening
decisions.reason: Luke says it is told to the people, but the leaders know it is about them (20:19).

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs to the end of 20:16
alternatives: a new quotation for each part of the story
decisions.reason: The whole parable is Jesus' speech. What the people in the story say is in single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: tenant farmers (L); tenants (B); farmers, who would take care of it for him (R)
decisions.reason: The word means farmers, but here they farm land they do not own (m2). Literal and Balanced say so; Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: a field where grapes grow
decisions.reason: Readable says what a vineyard is.

decisions.choice: parábola (L, B); historia (R)
decisions.reason: The term used throughout Luke, recorded once in this file. Readable says "historia", as the English Readable says "story". The same in verse 19.

decisions.choice: labradores (L, R); arrendatarios (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of these tenant farmers: the Greek word is simply "farmers", whom the lease makes tenants (meaning decision m2). Balanced says "arrendatarios", as the English Balanced says "tenants", so its verb is "dejó a cargo" rather than a second "arrendó".

decisions.choice: des vignerons (L, B); des cultivateurs, qui devaient s’en occuper pour lui (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12: "vigneron" is the French word for a man who works a vineyard, and "l’a louée à" says that the land was not theirs (m2), so Literal and Balanced need no word for "tenant". Readable uses the general word and explains the arrangement, as the English Readable does; "métayer" is a legal term few readers know.

decisions.choice: une parabole (L, B); une histoire (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "story", and as in Luke 19:11 and Mark 12:1.

decisions.choice: mfano
decisions.reason: The term used throughout Luke, recorded once in this file. "Mfano" is the Swahili word for a parable, a story that compares; "methali" is a proverb. Readable keeps "mfano" where the English Readable says "story", as the shared term list has it. The same in verse 19.

decisions.choice: "ngụ ngôn" (L, B); "câu chuyện" (R) for parable (also 20:19)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 19:11.

decisions.choice: "tá điền" (L, B); "nông dân" (R) for the tenant farmers (whole parable)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 12:1-9, so the parallel parables read alike.

source.text: καὶ καιρῷ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς δοῦλον, ἵνα ἀπὸ τοῦ καρποῦ τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος δώσουσιν αὐτῷ· οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν δείραντες κενόν.

records.literal_gloss: And at season he sent to the farmers a slave, so that from the fruit of the vineyard they will give to him; but the farmers sent away him having beaten empty.

en.L: And at the [harvest] season he sent a slave to the tenant farmers, so that they would give him [some] of the fruit of the vineyard; but the tenant farmers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
en.B: When harvest time came, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the vineyard's crop. But the tenants beat him and sent him back with nothing.
en.R: When it was time to pick the grapes, the owner sent one of his servants to the farmers. The servant was to get the owner's share of the grapes. But the farmers beat the servant and sent him away with nothing.

es.L: Y en el tiempo [de la cosecha] envió un esclavo a los labradores, para que le dieran [parte] del fruto de la viña; pero los labradores, después de golpearlo, lo despidieron vacío.
es.B: Cuando llegó el tiempo de la cosecha, envió un siervo a los arrendatarios para que le entregaran su parte del fruto de la viña. Pero los arrendatarios lo golpearon y lo despidieron con las manos vacías.
es.R: Cuando llegó el tiempo de recoger las uvas, el dueño envió a uno de sus siervos a ver a los labradores. El siervo debía recoger la parte de la cosecha que le correspondía al dueño. Pero los labradores le dieron una paliza al siervo y lo despidieron sin nada.

fr.L: Et au moment [de la récolte], il a envoyé un esclave aux vignerons, pour qu’ils lui donnent [une part] du fruit de la vigne ; mais les vignerons, l’ayant battu, l’ont renvoyé les mains vides.
fr.B: Quand le temps de la récolte est venu, il a envoyé un serviteur aux vignerons pour recevoir sa part du produit de la vigne. Mais les vignerons l’ont battu et l’ont renvoyé sans rien.
fr.R: Quand le moment de cueillir le raisin est arrivé, le propriétaire a envoyé un de ses serviteurs chez les cultivateurs. Le serviteur devait rapporter la part de raisin du propriétaire. Mais les cultivateurs ont battu le serviteur et l’ont renvoyé sans rien.

sw.L: Na kwa wakati [wa mavuno] alimtuma mtumwa kwa wakulima, ili wampe [sehemu] ya matunda ya shamba la mizabibu; lakini wakulima walimpiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
sw.B: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, alimtuma mtumishi kwa wakulima ili wampe sehemu yake ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu. Lakini wakulima walimpiga, wakamrudisha mikono mitupu.
sw.R: Wakati wa kuchuma zabibu ulipofika, mwenye shamba alimtuma mmoja wa watumishi wake kwa wakulima. Mtumishi huyo alipaswa kuchukua sehemu ya mavuno ya mwenye shamba. Lakini wakulima walimpiga mtumishi huyo, wakamfukuza bila kitu.

vi.L: Và đến mùa, ông sai một nô lệ đến với các tá điền, để họ nộp cho người ấy [phần] hoa lợi của vườn nho; nhưng các tá điền đánh đập người ấy và đuổi về tay không.
vi.B: Đến mùa thu hoạch, ông sai một đầy tớ đến với các tá điền để thu phần hoa lợi của vườn nho. Nhưng các tá điền đánh đập người ấy và đuổi về, không cho gì cả.
vi.R: Đến mùa hái nho, ông chủ sai một đầy tớ đến với những người nông dân. Người đầy tớ phải mang về phần nho của ông chủ. Nhưng những người nông dân đánh đập người đầy tớ và đuổi anh ta về mà không cho gì cả.

decisions.choice: at the season: at harvest, when the owner's agreed share of the crop was due
alternatives: at a time the owner chose
decisions.reason: The word means the right or fitting time; for a vineyard, the time of harvest. The owner asks only for what the lease gave him, some of the fruit.

decisions.choice: a slave: in the story, a figure for the prophets God sent to Israel
alternatives: an ordinary detail of the story
decisions.reason: Scripture speaks of God's servants the prophets, sent again and again and rejected (Jeremiah 7:25-26; 2 Chronicles 36:15-16). Jesus has said the same of Jerusalem (11:47-51; 13:34).

decisions.choice: empty-handed: with nothing
decisions.reason: The word means empty. The slave brought back none of the fruit.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m2) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave". The servant stands for the prophets, whom Scripture calls God's servants (m2).

decisions.choice: the owner (R); he (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable calls the man who planted the vineyard "the owner" all through the story; Literal and Balanced call him "master" where the Greek has that word (20:13).

decisions.choice: esclavo (L); siervo (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering, recorded once in this file: Literal keeps that the man was owned and sent to act in his master's name; Balanced and Readable say "siervo", as the English says "servant". The same in verse 11.

decisions.choice: esclave (L); serviteur (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, as the English and Luke 19:13: Literal keeps that the man was owned (m2), Balanced and Readable say "serviteur", which also recalls the prophets as God's servants. This holds for the whole parable.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (L); mtumishi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering, recorded once in this file: Literal keeps that the man was owned and sent to act in his master's name; Balanced and Readable say "mtumishi", as the English says "servant". The same in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R) for doulos (whole parable)
decisions.reason: The style guide's rule for doulos, as in Mark 12:2.

source.text: καὶ προσέθετο ἕτερον πέμψαι δοῦλον· οἱ δὲ κἀκεῖνον δείραντες καὶ ἀτιμάσαντες ἐξαπέστειλαν κενόν.

records.literal_gloss: And he added another to send slave; but they also that one having beaten and having dishonored sent away empty.

en.L: And he went on to send another slave; but they beat that one too and treated [him] shamefully and sent [him] away empty-handed.
en.B: So he sent a second servant, but they beat this one as well, insulted him, and sent him off with nothing.
en.R: So the owner sent another servant. The farmers beat him too. They treated him shamefully and sent him away with nothing.

es.L: Y volvió a enviar otro esclavo; pero también a ese lo golpearon y [lo] deshonraron y [lo] despidieron vacío.
es.B: Entonces envió un segundo siervo, pero también a este lo golpearon, lo insultaron y lo despidieron sin nada.
es.R: Entonces el dueño envió otro siervo. Los labradores también lo golpearon. Lo trataron de manera vergonzosa y lo despidieron sin nada.

fr.L: Et il a encore envoyé un autre esclave ; mais celui-là aussi, ils l’ont battu, l’ont couvert d’outrages et l’ont renvoyé les mains vides.
fr.B: Il a donc envoyé un deuxième serviteur, mais ils ont battu celui-là aussi, l’ont insulté et l’ont renvoyé sans rien.
fr.R: Alors le propriétaire a envoyé un autre serviteur. Les cultivateurs l’ont battu, lui aussi. Ils l’ont traité de façon honteuse et l’ont renvoyé sans rien.

sw.L: Na akaongeza kutuma mtumwa mwingine; lakini wao, wakimpiga huyo pia na kumwaibisha, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
sw.B: Basi akamtuma mtumishi wa pili, lakini huyu naye wakampiga, wakamtukana, wakamfukuza bila kitu.
sw.R: Basi mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi mwingine. Wakulima walimpiga huyo pia. Walimtendea mambo ya aibu, wakamfukuza bila kitu.

vi.L: Và ông lại sai một nô lệ khác; nhưng họ cũng đánh đập và sỉ nhục người này rồi đuổi về tay không.
vi.B: Ông lại sai một đầy tớ khác, nhưng họ cũng đánh đập người này, sỉ nhục anh ta, rồi đuổi về, không cho gì cả.
vi.R: Vì vậy ông chủ sai một đầy tớ khác. Những người nông dân cũng đánh đập anh ta. Họ làm nhục anh ta và đuổi anh ta về mà không cho gì cả.

decisions.choice: he added to send: he sent again
alternatives: he sent an extra slave along with the first
decisions.reason: "He added" with another verb is a Hebrew way of saying that someone did a thing again, common in the Greek Old Testament (Genesis 4:2; 8:12).

decisions.choice: treated shamefully: insulted and humiliated
decisions.reason: The verb means to take away someone's honor. The tenants add disgrace to the beating.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: As in 20:10: "servant" in Balanced and Readable (style guide); Literal keeps "slave".

source.text: καὶ προσέθετο τρίτον πέμψαι· οἱ δὲ καὶ τοῦτον τραυματίσαντες ἐξέβαλον.

records.literal_gloss: And he added a third to send; but they also this one having wounded threw out.

en.L: And he went on to send a third; but they wounded this one too and threw [him] out.
en.B: Then he sent a third, and they wounded this one and threw him out.
en.R: Then the owner sent a third servant. The farmers hurt him badly and threw him out of the vineyard.

es.L: Y volvió a enviar un tercero; pero también a este lo hirieron y [lo] echaron fuera.
es.B: Luego envió un tercero, y a este lo hirieron y lo echaron fuera.
es.R: Después el dueño envió un tercer siervo. Los labradores lo hirieron gravemente y lo echaron de la viña.

fr.L: Et il en a encore envoyé un troisième ; mais celui-là aussi, ils l’ont blessé et jeté dehors.
fr.B: Puis il en a envoyé un troisième, et ils l’ont blessé et jeté dehors.
fr.R: Ensuite, le propriétaire a envoyé un troisième serviteur. Les cultivateurs l’ont gravement blessé et l’ont jeté hors de la vigne.

sw.L: Na akaongeza kutuma wa tatu; lakini huyu pia walimjeruhi, wakamtupa nje.
sw.B: Kisha akamtuma wa tatu, nao wakamjeruhi huyu pia, wakamtupa nje.
sw.R: Kisha mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi wa tatu. Wakulima walimjeruhi vibaya, wakamtupa nje ya shamba.

vi.L: Và ông lại sai người thứ ba; nhưng họ cũng làm người này bị thương rồi ném ra ngoài.
vi.B: Ông lại sai người thứ ba, và họ đánh người này bị thương rồi quăng ra ngoài.
vi.R: Rồi ông chủ sai một đầy tớ thứ ba. Những người nông dân đánh anh ta bị thương nặng và ném anh ta ra khỏi vườn nho.

decisions.choice: wounded and threw out: the violence grows with each slave
decisions.reason: The first is beaten, the second beaten and shamed, the third wounded and thrown out. The next one sent will be killed (20:15).

decisions.choice: a third servant; out of the vineyard
decisions.reason: Readable says who was sent and where he was thrown.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος· Τί ποιήσω;

records.literal_gloss: Said then the master of the vineyard, What shall I do?

en.L: Then the master of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do?
en.B: Then the master of the vineyard said, 'What am I to do?
en.R: Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What should I do?

es.L: Entonces el señor de la viña dijo: “¿Qué haré?
es.B: Entonces el señor de la viña dijo: “¿Qué voy a hacer?
es.R: Entonces el dueño de la viña dijo: “¿Qué debo hacer?

fr.L: Alors le maître de la vigne a dit : “Que ferai-je ?
fr.B: Le maître de la vigne s’est dit alors : “Que dois-je faire ?
fr.R: Alors le propriétaire de la vigne a dit : “Qu’est-ce que je dois faire ?

sw.L: Ndipo bwana wa shamba la mizabibu akasema, 'Nifanye nini?
sw.B: Kisha bwana wa shamba la mizabibu akasema, 'Nitafanya nini?
sw.R: Kisha mwenye shamba la mizabibu akasema, 'Nifanye nini?

vi.L: Bấy giờ chủ vườn nho nói: 'Ta phải làm gì?
vi.B: Bấy giờ chủ vườn nho nói: 'Ta phải làm sao đây?
vi.R: Bấy giờ ông chủ vườn nho nói: 'Ta nên làm gì đây?

decisions.choice: What shall I do?: the owner's patience
decisions.reason: Instead of punishing the tenants, the owner looks for one more way to reach them, as God sent prophet after prophet before judging (2 Chronicles 36:15-16).

decisions.choice: the master: the owner of the vineyard
decisions.reason: In the parable the word means the man who owns the vineyard, as "lord of the vineyard" in 20:15. He stands for God, but within the story he is a figure, not addressed as God.

decisions.choice: owner (R); master (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 20:10: Readable says "owner"; Literal and Balanced keep "master", the Luke convention for this word in parables.

decisions.choice: the owner's words open here in single quotation marks and close at the end of 20:13
decisions.reason: His thoughts go on in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: le maître de la vigne (L, B); le propriétaire de la vigne (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: "maître" is the owner of a slave and of land, which goes with "esclave" and "serviteur" (Luke 19:16); Readable says "propriétaire" all through the story.

decisions.choice: the owner says "ta" of himself (lowercase in mid-sentence, no span)
decisions.reason: As the master in Luke 14:23-24 and the king in 19:13-27: a figure in a parable, not a pronoun for God.

source.text: πέμψω τὸν υἱόν μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν· ἴσως τοῦτον ἐντραπήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: I will send the son of me the beloved; perhaps this one they will respect.

en.L: I will send my beloved son; perhaps they will respect him.'
en.B: I will send my son, the one I love. It may be that they will show him respect.'
en.R: I will send my own dear son. Maybe they will treat him with respect.'

es.L: Enviaré a mi hijo, el amado; quizá a este lo respetarán”.
es.B: Enviaré a mi hijo, a quien amo. Puede ser que a él lo respeten”.
es.R: Enviaré a mi querido hijo. Tal vez a él lo traten con respeto”.

fr.L: J’enverrai mon fils bien-aimé ; peut-être le respecteront-ils.”
fr.B: Je vais envoyer mon fils, celui que j’aime. Peut-être qu’ils auront du respect pour lui.”
fr.R: Je vais envoyer mon fils, que j’aime tant. Ils vont peut-être le respecter.”

sw.L: Nitamtuma mwanangu mpendwa; huenda huyu watamheshimu.'
sw.B: Nitamtuma mwanangu, yule ninayempenda. Yamkini yeye watamheshimu.'
sw.R: Nitamtuma mwanangu mpendwa mwenyewe. Labda watamtendea kwa heshima.'

vi.L: Ta sẽ sai con trai yêu dấu của ta; có lẽ họ sẽ kính nể nó.'
vi.B: Ta sẽ sai con trai ta, đứa con ta yêu quý. Có lẽ họ sẽ tôn trọng nó.'
vi.R: Ta sẽ sai chính con trai yêu quý của ta. Có lẽ họ sẽ tôn trọng nó.'

decisions.choice: my beloved son: the words God spoke of Jesus at his baptism
alternatives: only a father's affection in the story
decisions.reason: At the baptism the voice from heaven said, "You are my beloved son" (3:22). The hearers do not know that yet, but Luke's readers do: the son in the story stands for Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: respect: show regard, feel shame before
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn toward someone with respect (18:2, 4). The owner hopes they will honor his son as they would not honor his slaves.

decisions.choice: perhaps: the owner hopes for the best
decisions.reason: The word expresses a real possibility, not certainty.

decisions.choice: the one I love (B); my own dear son (R); my beloved son (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use everyday words for "beloved". Literal keeps the word that recalls 3:22.

decisions.choice: him (no deity_pronoun setting)
decisions.reason: The son is a figure in the parable, so the pronoun for him takes no setting, even though the figure points to Jesus.

decisions.choice: "con trai yêu dấu" (L); "đứa con ta yêu quý" (B); "con trai yêu quý" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word of God's voice at Jesus' baptism (meaning decision), as in Mark 12:6.

source.text: ἰδόντες δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ γεωργοὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος· ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτόν, ἵνα ἡμῶν γένηται ἡ κληρονομία·

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then him the farmers reasoned with one another saying, This is the heir; let us kill him, so that ours may become the inheritance;

en.L: But when the tenant farmers saw him, they reasoned with one another, saying, 'This is the heir; let us kill him, so that the inheritance may become ours.'
en.B: But the tenants saw him coming and talked it over among themselves. 'This is the one who will inherit,' they said to each other. 'If we kill him, the property will be ours.'
en.R: But when the farmers saw the son, they talked it over together. They said, 'This is the son who will one day own the vineyard. Let us kill him. Then the vineyard will belong to us!'

es.L: Pero al verlo, los labradores razonaban unos con otros, diciendo: “Este es el heredero; matémoslo, para que la herencia sea nuestra”.
es.B: Pero cuando los arrendatarios lo vieron venir, lo hablaron entre ellos. “Este es el que va a heredar”, se decían. “Si lo matamos, la propiedad será nuestra”.
es.R: Pero cuando los labradores vieron al hijo, lo hablaron entre ellos. Dijeron: “Este es el hijo que algún día será dueño de la viña. ¡Matémoslo! Así la viña será nuestra”.

fr.L: Mais, l’ayant vu, les vignerons se sont concertés entre eux, disant : “Celui-ci est l’héritier ; tuons-le, afin que l’héritage soit à nous.”
fr.B: Mais les vignerons, en le voyant venir, se sont concertés. “C’est lui qui va hériter, se sont-ils dit. Si nous le tuons, la propriété sera à nous.”
fr.R: Mais quand les cultivateurs ont vu le fils, ils en ont parlé entre eux. Ils ont dit : “C’est le fils qui sera un jour le propriétaire de la vigne. Tuons-le ! Alors la vigne sera à nous !”

sw.L: Lakini wakulima walipomwona, walijadiliana wao kwa wao, wakisema, 'Huyu ndiye mrithi; tumuue, ili urithi uwe wetu.'
sw.B: Lakini wakulima walipomwona akija, walishauriana wao kwa wao. Wakaambiana, 'Huyu ndiye atakayerithi. Tukimuua, mali hii itakuwa yetu.'
sw.R: Lakini wakulima walipomwona mwana huyo, walizungumza pamoja. Wakasema, 'Huyu ndiye mwana atakayekuwa mwenye shamba siku moja. Tumuue! Kisha shamba litakuwa letu!'

vi.L: Nhưng khi thấy người ấy, các tá điền bàn với nhau rằng: 'Đây là người thừa kế; chúng ta hãy giết nó, để gia tài thuộc về chúng ta.'
vi.B: Nhưng khi các tá điền thấy người con, họ bàn với nhau: 'Đây là người sẽ thừa kế. Chúng ta giết nó đi, rồi gia tài sẽ về tay chúng ta.'
vi.R: Nhưng khi những người nông dân thấy người con, họ bàn với nhau: 'Đây là người con sẽ làm chủ vườn nho sau này. Chúng ta hãy giết nó đi. Rồi vườn nho sẽ thuộc về chúng ta!'

decisions.choice: the heir; the inheritance: the son who would receive the vineyard, and the vineyard itself
decisions.reason: The story does not explain how killing the heir would give them the land. Perhaps they think the owner far away or dead, and that land with no heir could be held by those who work it. The point is their greed and their contempt for the owner.

decisions.choice: let us kill him: Jesus foretells his own death at the hands of Israel's leaders
decisions.reason: Jesus has said that the chief priests, scribes and elders will reject him and that he will be killed (9:22; 18:31-33). The leaders listening understand that the story is about them (20:19).

decisions.choice: reasoned with one another: the same kind of talk as the leaders' in 20:5
decisions.reason: Luke uses similar words for the tenants and for the leaders who weighed their answer among themselves. The hearers can see themselves in the story.

decisions.choice: the one who will inherit; the property
decisions.reason: Balanced uses plain words for the legal terms.

decisions.choice: the son; who will one day own the vineyard
decisions.reason: Readable names the son and says what an heir is.

decisions.choice: "nó" for the son in the tenants' words
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:7: the contemptuous word fits the tenants' plan.

source.text: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος ἀπέκτειναν.

records.literal_gloss: And having thrown him outside the vineyard they killed.

en.L: And they threw him out of the vineyard and killed [him].
en.B: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
en.R: So they threw the son out of the vineyard and killed him.

es.L: Y echándolo fuera de la viña, [lo] mataron.
es.B: Así que lo echaron fuera de la viña y lo mataron.
es.R: Entonces echaron al hijo fuera de la viña y lo mataron.

fr.L: Et, l’ayant jeté hors de la vigne, ils [l’]ont tué.
fr.B: Ils l’ont donc jeté hors de la vigne et l’ont tué.
fr.R: Alors ils ont jeté le fils hors de la vigne et ils l’ont tué.

sw.L: Na wakimtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, walimuua.
sw.B: Basi wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.
sw.R: Basi wakamtupa mwana huyo nje ya shamba, wakamuua.

vi.L: Và ném người ấy ra ngoài vườn nho, họ giết [người ấy].
vi.B: Thế là họ quăng anh ta ra ngoài vườn nho và giết đi.
vi.R: Vậy họ ném người con ra ngoài vườn nho và giết anh ta.

decisions.choice: threw him out, then killed him: the order of the two acts
alternatives: killed him and then threw him out
decisions.reason: In Mark 12:8 the tenants kill the son and then throw him out. Matthew 21:39 and Luke have the order here. Some see in it Jesus' death outside the city (Hebrews 13:12), but the parable does not say so.

decisions.choice: the son
decisions.reason: Readable names the son.

source.text: τί οὖν ποιήσει αὐτοῖς ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος;

records.literal_gloss: What therefore will do to them the master of the vineyard?

en.L: What, then, will the master of the vineyard do to them?
en.B: So what will the master of the vineyard do to them?
en.R: What do you think the owner of the vineyard will do to them?

es.L: ¿Qué, pues, les hará el señor de la viña?
es.B: Entonces, ¿qué les hará el señor de la viña?
es.R: ¿Qué {{plural_you:creen|creéis}} que les hará el dueño de la viña?

fr.L: Que leur fera donc le maître de la vigne ?
fr.B: Alors, que leur fera le maître de la vigne ?
fr.R: À votre avis, que va leur faire le propriétaire de la vigne ?

sw.L: Basi, bwana wa shamba la mizabibu atawafanya nini?
sw.B: Basi, bwana wa shamba la mizabibu atawatendea nini?
sw.R: Mnadhani mwenye shamba la mizabibu atawafanya nini?

vi.L: Vậy chủ vườn nho sẽ làm gì họ?
vi.B: Vậy chủ vườn nho sẽ xử họ thế nào?
vi.R: Các người nghĩ ông chủ vườn nho sẽ làm gì những người ấy?

decisions.choice: a question to the hearers, which Jesus answers himself
decisions.reason: Jesus asks the question and gives the answer in the next sentence, as in Mark 12:9.

decisions.choice: do you think
decisions.reason: Readable shows that Jesus is asking his hearers.

decisions.choice: the owner (R); the master (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 20:13.

source.text: ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἀπολέσει τοὺς γεωργοὺς τούτους, καὶ δώσει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλοις.

records.literal_gloss: He will come and will destroy the farmers these, and will give the vineyard to others.

en.L: He will come and destroy these tenant farmers and give the vineyard to others."
en.B: He will come and put these tenants to death, and give the vineyard to others."
en.R: He will come and kill those farmers. Then he will give the vineyard to other people to take care of."

es.L: Vendrá y destruirá a estos labradores, y dará la viña a otros».
es.B: Vendrá, dará muerte a esos arrendatarios y entregará la viña a otros».
es.R: Vendrá y matará a esos labradores. Luego les dará la viña a otras personas para que la cuiden».

fr.L: Il viendra et fera périr ces vignerons, et il donnera la vigne à d’autres. »
fr.B: Il viendra, fera mourir ces vignerons et donnera la vigne à d’autres. »
fr.R: Il va venir et tuer ces cultivateurs. Ensuite, il donnera la vigne à d’autres personnes pour qu’elles s’en occupent. »

sw.L: Atakuja na kuwaangamiza wakulima hawa, na kuwapa wengine shamba la mizabibu."
sw.B: Atakuja, awaue wakulima hao, na kuwakabidhi wengine shamba la mizabibu."
sw.R: Atakuja na kuwaua wakulima hao. Kisha atawapa watu wengine shamba hilo walitunze."

vi.L: Ông sẽ đến và tiêu diệt các tá điền ấy, và giao vườn nho cho những người khác."
vi.B: Ông sẽ đến giết những tá điền ấy, và giao vườn nho cho người khác."
vi.R: Ông sẽ đến và giết những người nông dân đó. Rồi ông sẽ giao vườn nho cho những người khác chăm sóc."

decisions.choice: to others: new people put in charge of God's people, in place of the leaders
alternatives: the Gentiles in place of Israel
decisions.reason: In the story the vineyard is not destroyed; the tenants are replaced. The leaders understand that they are the tenants (20:19). Jesus will give his apostles a share in ruling Israel (22:29-30). Some read "others" as the Gentiles.

decisions.choice: destroy: put to death
decisions.reason: The verb is used of killing (6:9; 17:27; 19:47). Jesus has also warned of the destruction of Jerusalem (19:43-44).

decisions.choice: the quotation that opened at 20:9 closes here
decisions.reason: Jesus answers his own question, and the parable ends.

decisions.choice: to take care of
decisions.reason: Readable says why the vineyard is given to others.

source.text: ἀκούσαντες δὲ εἶπαν· Μὴ γένοιτο.

records.literal_gloss: Having heard then they said, Not may it be!

en.L: And when they heard [this], they said, "May it never be!"
en.B: Hearing this, the people cried out, "May that never happen!"
en.R: The people heard this and said, "No! That must never happen!"

es.L: Y cuando [lo] oyeron, dijeron: «¡No suceda tal cosa!».
es.B: Al oír esto, la gente exclamó: «¡Que eso nunca ocurra!».
es.R: La gente oyó esto y dijo: «¡No! ¡Eso no puede pasar nunca!».

fr.L: Et, ayant entendu [cela], ils dirent : « Que cela ne soit jamais ! »
fr.B: En entendant cela, les gens s’écrièrent : « Que cela n’arrive jamais ! »
fr.R: Les gens ont entendu cela et ils ont dit : « Non ! Cela ne doit jamais arriver ! »

sw.L: Nao waliposikia [hayo], wakasema, "Isiwe hivyo!"
sw.B: Watu waliposikia hayo, wakasema kwa sauti, "Jambo hilo lisitokee kamwe!"
sw.R: Watu walisikia hayo, wakasema, "Hapana! Jambo hilo lisitokee kamwe!"

vi.L: Và nghe [vậy], họ nói: "Nguyện điều ấy không bao giờ xảy ra!"
vi.B: Nghe vậy, dân chúng kêu lên: "Không bao giờ có chuyện ấy!"
vi.R: Dân chúng nghe vậy thì nói: "Không! Chuyện đó không được xảy ra!"

decisions.choice: may it never be: a strong wish that something not happen
decisions.reason: The phrase is a strong refusal, used often by Paul (Romans 3:4, 6). The hearers recoil from what the story threatens.

decisions.choice: they: the people who heard the parable
decisions.reason: The parable was told to the people (20:9). They see that it speaks of judgment on Israel's leaders and of the vineyard given to others.

decisions.choice: the people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who answered (m2).

decisions.choice: "Nguyện điều ấy không bao giờ xảy ra" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the form of a wish (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say it as a natural cry.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς εἶπεν· Τί οὖν ἐστιν τὸ γεγραμμένον τοῦτο· Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας;

records.literal_gloss: But he having looked at them said, What then is the having been written this: [The] stone which rejected the [ones] building, this has become into head of corner?

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looked at them and said, "What then is this that is written: 'The stone which the builders rejected, this has become [the] head of [the] corner'?
en.B: Jesus looked straight at them and said, "Then what is the meaning of the words that are written, 'The stone the builders discarded has become the main stone at the corner'?
en.R: Jesus looked at them and said, "Then what do these words in the Scriptures mean? 'The stone that the builders threw away has become the most important stone in the building.'

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, mirándolos fijamente, dijo: «¿Qué es, entonces, esto que está escrito: “La piedra que rechazaron los que edificaban, esta ha llegado a ser cabeza de [la] esquina”?
es.B: Jesús los miró fijamente y dijo: «Entonces, ¿qué significan estas palabras que están escritas: “La piedra que los constructores desecharon se ha convertido en la piedra principal de la esquina”?
es.R: Jesús los miró y dijo: «Entonces, ¿qué quieren decir estas palabras de las Escrituras? “La piedra que los constructores tiraron se ha convertido en la piedra más importante del edificio”.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les regarda et dit : « Qu’est-ce donc que ceci, qui est écrit : “La pierre que les bâtisseurs ont rejetée, celle-ci est devenue la tête de l’angle” ?
fr.B: Jésus les regarda droit dans les yeux et dit : « Que veut donc dire ce qui est écrit : “La pierre que les bâtisseurs ont mise au rebut est devenue la pierre principale de l’angle” ?
fr.R: Jésus les a regardés et il a dit : « Alors, que veulent dire ces paroles des Écritures ? “La pierre que les bâtisseurs ont jetée est devenue la pierre la plus importante de la construction.”

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, akiwakazia macho, akasema, "Basi ni nini hili lililoandikwa: 'Jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilikataa, hilo limekuwa kichwa cha pembe'?
sw.B: Yesu akawakazia macho, akasema, "Basi maneno haya yaliyoandikwa yana maana gani: 'Jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilitupa limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni'?
sw.R: Yesu akawatazama, akasema, "Basi maneno haya ya Maandiko yana maana gani? 'Jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilitupa limekuwa jiwe muhimu kuliko yote katika jengo.'

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhìn thẳng vào họ và nói: "Vậy lời đã chép này là gì: 'Hòn đá mà những người thợ xây đã loại bỏ, chính hòn đá ấy đã trở thành đầu góc nhà'?
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nhìn thẳng vào họ và nói: "Thế thì lời Kinh Thánh này có nghĩa gì: 'Hòn đá bị thợ xây loại bỏ đã trở thành tảng đá góc nhà quan trọng nhất'?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nhìn họ và nói: "Vậy những lời này trong Kinh Thánh có nghĩa gì? 'Thợ xây không muốn dùng một hòn đá kia. Nhưng hòn đá ấy đã trở thành hòn đá quan trọng nhất của ngôi nhà.'

decisions.choice: Psalm 118:22: the rejected stone becomes the chief stone
decisions.reason: The words come from the psalm the crowd sang when Jesus entered the city (19:38, Psalm 118:26). The builders stand for Israel's leaders, who reject Jesus, and God gives him the chief place. Peter uses the verse in the same way (Acts 4:11; 1 Peter 2:7). The Greek follows the Greek Old Testament, which matches the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: head of the corner: the main stone at the corner of a building, which holds two walls together
alternatives: the capstone at the top of an arch or wall
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean the cornerstone laid at the foundation or the stone set at the top of a building. Either way it is the most important stone, the one the builders threw away.

decisions.choice: What then is this that is written?: if the hearers say it must never happen, what does Scripture mean?
decisions.reason: The people have just said "May it never be!" (20:16). Jesus answers that Scripture itself foretells the rejection of the stone and God's raising it up.

decisions.choice: looked at them: looked straight at them
decisions.reason: The verb means to look intently, as when the Lord looks at Peter (22:61).

decisions.choice: discarded; the main stone at the corner (B); threw away; the most important stone in the building (R)
alternatives: rejected; the head of the corner
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say in plain words what the image means (m2). Literal keeps the psalm's own phrase.

decisions.choice: Jesus' words open here and run to the end of 20:18; the psalm is in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: Jesus goes on speaking in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: "đầu góc nhà" (L); "tảng đá góc nhà quan trọng nhất" (B); "hòn đá quan trọng nhất của ngôi nhà" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of Psalm 118:22 in the Vietnamese Mark 12:10.

source.text: πᾶς ὁ πεσὼν ἐπ’ ἐκεῖνον τὸν λίθον συνθλασθήσεται· ἐφ’ ὃν δ’ ἂν πέσῃ, λικμήσει αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Everyone falling on that the stone will be broken; on whom but it may fall, it will crush him.

en.L: Everyone who falls on that stone will be shattered; and on whomever it falls, it will crush {{gender:that person|him}} to powder."
en.B: All who fall on that stone will be smashed, and if it falls on someone, it will grind {{gender:that person|him}} to dust."
en.R: Anyone who falls on that stone will be smashed. And if that stone falls on anyone, it will crush {{gender:them|him}} to dust."

es.L: Todo el que caiga sobre aquella piedra será despedazado; y sobre quien ella caiga, lo desmenuzará».
es.B: Todo el que caiga sobre esa piedra quedará hecho pedazos, y si ella cae sobre alguien, lo reducirá a polvo».
es.R: Cualquiera que caiga sobre esa piedra quedará hecho pedazos. Y si esa piedra cae sobre alguien, lo hará polvo».

fr.L: Quiconque tombe sur cette pierre-là sera brisé ; et celui sur qui elle tombera, elle le réduira en poussière. »
fr.B: Tous ceux qui tomberont sur cette pierre seront mis en pièces, et si elle tombe sur quelqu’un, elle le broiera. »
fr.R: Celui qui tombe sur cette pierre sera brisé en morceaux. Et si cette pierre tombe sur quelqu’un, elle l’écrasera complètement. »

sw.L: Kila aangukaye juu ya jiwe lile atavunjika vipande vipande; na yeyote ambaye jiwe hilo litamwangukia, litamsaga."
sw.B: Kila mtu aangukaye juu ya jiwe hilo atavunjika vipande vipande, na likimwangukia mtu, litamsaga kuwa mavumbi."
sw.R: Mtu yeyote akianguka juu ya jiwe hilo atavunjika vipande vipande. Na jiwe hilo likimwangukia mtu yeyote, litamsaga kuwa vumbi."

vi.L: Hễ ai ngã trên hòn đá ấy sẽ bị vỡ nát; còn hòn đá ấy rơi trên ai, thì sẽ nghiền người ấy ra bụi."
vi.B: Ai ngã trên hòn đá ấy sẽ bị dập nát, và hòn đá ấy rơi trúng ai thì sẽ nghiền nát người ấy như bụi."
vi.R: Ai ngã trên hòn đá ấy sẽ bị vỡ tan. Còn nếu hòn đá ấy rơi trúng ai, nó sẽ nghiền người ấy ra như bụi."

decisions.choice: the stone that breaks and crushes: Isaiah 8:14-15 and Daniel 2:34-35, 44-45
alternatives: a new picture with no background
decisions.reason: Isaiah speaks of a stone over which many will stumble and fall and be broken. Daniel tells of a stone cut without hands that strikes the statue of the kingdoms and grinds it to chaff; it stands for the kingdom God sets up. Jesus joins the pictures: the rejected stone judges those who reject it.

decisions.choice: crush to powder: grind to dust
decisions.reason: The verb first meant to winnow, to toss grain so the wind blows away the chaff, and then to scatter or crush. In the Greek of Daniel 2:44 it describes the stone crushing the kingdoms, which suits the picture of a falling stone here.

decisions.choice: falls on that stone: whoever opposes Jesus is broken by him
decisions.reason: The stone is Jesus (20:17). Whether people fall against him or he falls on them in judgment, those who reject him are destroyed (2:34).

decisions.choice: {{gender:that person|him}} (L, B); {{gender:them|him}} (R)
decisions.reason: The saying speaks of anyone at all, man or woman.

decisions.choice: the quotation that opened at 20:17 closes here
decisions.reason: Jesus' words end with this saying.

decisions.choice: lo, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "that person" against "him". Spanish refers back to "todo el que" and "alguien" with the one pronoun "lo", which covers anyone, so there is no second wording for the setting to choose.

decisions.choice: celui sur qui (L); quelqu’un (B, R) ... le, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender setting, as the English "that person / him", "them / him"
decisions.reason: As the style guide says, "celui qui", "quiconque" and "quelqu’un" already mean anyone in French, and the "le" that refers back to them is ordinary generic French, so French needs no setting where the English needs one.

decisions.choice: "ai ... người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người ấy" already covers a man or a woman, so the English gender setting has nothing to change.

source.text: καὶ ἐζήτησαν οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐπιβαλεῖν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν λαόν, ἔγνωσαν γὰρ ὅτι πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην.

records.literal_gloss: And sought the scribes and the chief priests to lay on him the hands in same the hour, and they feared the people; they knew for that against them he spoke the parable this.

en.L: And the scribes and the chief priests sought to lay [their] hands on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in that very hour, but they feared the people, for they knew that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had told this parable against them.
en.B: The scribes and the chief priests wanted to get their hands on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} then and there, but they were afraid of the people. They understood that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had aimed this parable at them.
en.R: The teachers of the law and the chief priests wanted to arrest Jesus right away. But they were afraid of what the people would do. They knew that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had told the story about them, and that they were the wicked farmers.

es.L: Y los escribas y los jefes de los sacerdotes procuraron echar las manos sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en aquella misma hora, pero temieron al pueblo; porque sabían que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dicho esta parábola contra ellos.
es.B: Los escribas y los jefes de los sacerdotes quisieron apoderarse de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en ese mismo momento, pero tenían miedo del pueblo. Comprendieron que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dirigido esa parábola contra ellos.
es.R: Los maestros de la ley y los jefes de los sacerdotes querían arrestar a Jesús en ese mismo momento. Pero tenían miedo de lo que haría la gente. Sabían que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había contado la historia acerca de ellos, y que ellos eran los labradores malvados.

fr.L: Et les scribes et les chefs des prêtres cherchèrent à mettre la main sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à l’heure même, mais ils craignirent le peuple ; car ils avaient compris qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dit cette parabole contre eux.
fr.B: Les scribes et les chefs des prêtres voulurent {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}arrêter sur-le-champ, mais ils avaient peur du peuple. Ils avaient compris que c’était eux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} visait par cette parabole.
fr.R: Les spécialistes de la Loi et les chefs des prêtres voulaient arrêter Jésus tout de suite. Mais ils avaient peur de la réaction du peuple. Ils savaient qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait raconté cette histoire contre eux, et qu’ils étaient les méchants cultivateurs.

sw.L: Na waandishi na wakuu wa makuhani walitafuta kuweka mikono juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} saa ile ile, lakini waliwaogopa watu; kwa maana walijua kwamba alisema mfano huu dhidi yao.
sw.B: Waandishi na wakuu wa makuhani walitaka kumkamata papo hapo, lakini waliwaogopa watu. Walielewa kwamba mfano huo aliusema kwa kuwalenga wao.
sw.R: Walimu wa sheria na wakuu wa makuhani walitaka kumkamata Yesu mara moja. Lakini waliogopa watu wangefanya nini. Walijua kwamba Yesu alisema mfano huo kuwahusu wao, na kwamba wao ndio wale wakulima waovu.

vi.L: Và các thầy thông giáo và các thầy tế lễ cả tìm cách tra tay trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngay trong giờ đó, nhưng họ sợ dân chúng; vì họ biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kể ngụ ngôn này để nói về họ.
vi.B: Các thầy thông giáo và các thầy tế lễ cả muốn bắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngay lúc ấy, nhưng họ sợ dân chúng. Họ hiểu rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhắm vào họ khi kể ngụ ngôn này.
vi.R: Các thầy dạy luật và các thầy tế lễ cả muốn bắt Đức Giê-xu ngay lập tức. Nhưng họ sợ dân chúng phản ứng. Họ biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kể câu chuyện ấy để nói về họ, và họ chính là những người nông dân gian ác.

decisions.choice: lay hands on: seize, arrest
decisions.reason: The phrase means to take someone into custody (21:12; 22:53).

decisions.choice: and they feared: but they feared
decisions.reason: The word "and" here sets their fear against what they wanted, so it has the force of "but".

decisions.choice: for they knew: the reason they wanted to seize him
decisions.reason: The clause explains why they wanted to arrest him at once: they saw that the parable was aimed at them. Their fear of the people held them back.

decisions.choice: the teachers of the law and the chief priests
alternatives: the scribes and the chief priests
decisions.reason: As in 19:47: "scribes" today suggests people who copy documents, so Readable says what these men did.

decisions.choice: and that they were the wicked farmers
decisions.reason: Readable says how the parable was against them.

decisions.choice: "tra tay trên Ngài" (L); "bắt" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "lay hands on"; it means to arrest (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "nhưng" for "and" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek "and" here sets fear against intent (meaning decision); Vietnamese needs "nhưng" to be grammatical, as in Mark 12:12.

source.text: Καὶ παρατηρήσαντες ἀπέστειλαν ἐγκαθέτους ὑποκρινομένους ἑαυτοὺς δικαίους εἶναι, ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται αὐτοῦ λόγου, ὥστε παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν τῇ ἀρχῇ καὶ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος.

records.literal_gloss: And having watched closely they sent spies pretending themselves righteous to be, so that they might catch of him a word, so as to hand over him to the rule and to the authority of the governor.

en.L: And watching [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] closely, they sent spies who pretended to be righteous, so that they might catch {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in [some] word, so as to hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to the rule and the authority of the governor.
en.B: They watched {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} closely and sent agents who played the part of honest, devout men. Their aim was to seize on some word of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} and use it to deliver {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} into the governor's power and jurisdiction.
en.R: So the leaders watched Jesus closely. They sent some men to spy on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. These men pretended to be good people who wanted to obey God. They hoped to catch Jesus saying something wrong. Then they could hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to the Roman governor, who had the power to punish {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y, observando atentamente, enviaron espías que fingían ser justos, para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} sorprendieran en [alguna] palabra, de modo que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} pudieran entregar al poder y a la autoridad del gobernador.
es.B: Lo vigilaron de cerca y enviaron unos agentes que se hacían pasar por hombres honrados y piadosos. Querían aferrarse a alguna palabra {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}} y servirse de ella para entregarlo al poder y a la jurisdicción del gobernador.
es.R: Así que los dirigentes vigilaban de cerca a Jesús. Enviaron a unos hombres para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} espiaran. Esos hombres fingían ser buenas personas que querían obedecer a Dios. Esperaban sorprender a Jesús diciendo algo indebido. Así {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} podrían entregar al gobernador romano, que tenía poder para castigarlo.

fr.L: Et, [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]ayant observé de près, ils envoyèrent des espions qui feignaient d’être justes, afin de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prendre en défaut sur [quelque] parole, de façon à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livrer au pouvoir et à l’autorité du gouverneur.
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} surveillèrent de près et envoyèrent des agents qui jouaient le rôle d’hommes honnêtes et pieux. Ils voulaient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prendre au mot pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livrer au pouvoir et à la juridiction du gouverneur.
fr.R: Alors les chefs ont surveillé Jésus de près. Ils ont envoyé des hommes pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}espionner. Ces hommes faisaient semblant d’être des gens bien qui voulaient obéir à Dieu. Ils espéraient prendre Jésus en train de dire quelque chose de mal. Alors ils pourraient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livrer au gouverneur romain, qui avait le pouvoir de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} punir.

sw.L: Na wakimvizia, walituma wapelelezi waliojifanya kuwa wenye haki, ili wamnase katika neno, hata wamkabidhi kwa utawala na mamlaka ya mkuu wa mkoa.
sw.B: Wakamvizia, wakatuma vibaraka waliojifanya kuwa watu waaminifu wanaomcha Mungu. Lengo lao lilikuwa kunasa jambo fulani katika maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kulitumia ili wamkabidhi kwa nguvu na mamlaka ya mkuu wa mkoa.
sw.R: Basi viongozi walimchunguza Yesu kwa makini. Waliwatuma watu fulani wampeleleze. Watu hao walijifanya kuwa watu wema wanaotaka kumtii Mungu. Walitumaini kumnasa Yesu akisema jambo baya. Kisha wangeweza kumkabidhi kwa mkuu wa mkoa wa Kirumi, aliyekuwa na mamlaka ya kumwadhibu.

vi.L: Và theo dõi [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] kỹ lưỡng, họ sai những kẻ do thám giả làm người công chính, để bắt bẻ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong lời nói, hầu nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho quyền cai trị và thẩm quyền của quan tổng đốc.
vi.B: Họ theo dõi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sát sao và sai những người dò la đến, giả làm người ngay thẳng, mộ đạo. Họ muốn bắt lấy một lời nào đó của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để có cớ nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho quyền lực và thẩm quyền của quan tổng đốc.
vi.R: Vì thế các nhà lãnh đạo theo dõi Đức Giê-xu rất kỹ. Họ sai mấy người đến dò xét {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Những người này giả làm người tốt, muốn vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời. Họ hy vọng bắt được Đức Giê-xu nói điều gì sai. Rồi họ có thể nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho quan tổng đốc La Mã, là người có quyền trừng phạt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: spies: men hired or sent in secret to trap someone
decisions.reason: The word means someone planted or sent in secret to act for others. The leaders do not come themselves this time.

decisions.choice: righteous: sincere, law-keeping people with an honest question
decisions.reason: They pretend to be devout Jews troubled by a question of the law (20:22), not agents looking for a charge.

decisions.choice: the governor: the Roman governor of Judea, Pontius Pilate
