decisions.reason: Judea was ruled by a Roman governor (3:1), and only he could put someone to death (John 18:31). Jesus will be handed over to Pilate (23:1).

decisions.choice: catch him in a word: trap him by something he says
decisions.reason: The verb means to take hold of. They want a saying they can use against him (11:54).

decisions.choice: honest, devout men; the governor's power and jurisdiction
alternatives: righteous; the rule and the authority of the governor
decisions.reason: Balanced says what sort of righteousness they put on (m2) and puts the legal phrase in plain words.

decisions.choice: Roman; who had the power to punish him
decisions.reason: Readable says who the governor was and why they wanted him involved (m3).

decisions.choice: mkuu wa mkoa
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of the Roman governor (meaning decision m3), as in John 18-19, recorded once in this file. "Gavana" is a loanword; "liwali" is an older title for a local official under a sultan.

decisions.choice: "nộp" for "hand over"; "quan tổng đốc" for the governor
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:9 and Matthew 10:18.

decisions.choice: "người công chính" (L); "người ngay thẳng, mộ đạo" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the key word for righteousness; Balanced says what kind of men they pretended to be (meaning decision).

source.text: καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Διδάσκαλε, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὀρθῶς λέγεις καὶ διδάσκεις καὶ οὐ λαμβάνεις πρόσωπον, ἀλλ’ ἐπ’ ἀληθείας τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ θεοῦ διδάσκεις·

records.literal_gloss: And they asked him saying, Teacher, we know that rightly you speak and teach and not you receive face, but on truth the way of the God you teach;

en.L: And they questioned {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Teacher, we know that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} speak and teach rightly, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not receive [anyone's] face, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} teach the way of God in truth.
en.B: So they put a question to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: "Teacher, we are sure that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are correct in what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say and teach. No one's rank sways {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} teach the way of God with truth.
en.R: They asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, we know that everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say and teach is right. You treat everyone the same, whether they are important or not. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} teach the truth about the way God wants people to live.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron, diciendo: «Maestro, sabemos que hablas y enseñas rectamente, y no recibes [el] rostro [de nadie], sino que enseñas el camino de Dios con verdad.
es.B: Así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hicieron una pregunta: «Maestro, estamos seguros de que lo que dices y enseñas es correcto. No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dejas llevar por la posición de nadie, y enseñas el camino de Dios con verdad.
es.R: Le preguntaron: «Maestro, sabemos que todo lo que dices y enseñas es correcto. Tratas a todos por igual, sean importantes o no. Y enseñas la verdad sobre la manera en que Dios quiere que la gente viva.

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogèrent, disant : « Maître, nous savons que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} parles et enseignes avec droiture, et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne regardes pas au visage [de quiconque], mais que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseignes la voie de Dieu selon la vérité.
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} posèrent donc une question : « Maître, nous sommes sûrs que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis et enseignes ce qui est juste. Le rang des gens n’a pas d’influence sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseignes la voie de Dieu en toute vérité.
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont demandé : « Maître, nous savons que tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis et enseignes est juste. Tu traites tout le monde de la même façon, que les gens soient importants ou non. Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseignes la vérité sur la façon dont Dieu veut que les gens vivent.

sw.L: Nao wakamwuliza, wakisema, "Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unasema na kufundisha kwa usahihi, wala hupokei uso [wa mtu], bali unafundisha njia ya Mungu kwa kweli.
sw.B: Basi wakamwuliza swali: "Mwalimu, tuna hakika kwamba unayosema na kufundisha ni sahihi. Cheo cha mtu hakikuyumbishi, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unafundisha njia ya Mungu kwa kweli.
sw.R: Wakamwuliza, "Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba kila kitu unachosema na kufundisha ni sawa. Unawatendea watu wote sawa, wawe wakubwa au la. Tena unafundisha ukweli kuhusu njia ambayo Mungu anataka watu waishi.

vi.L: Và họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Thưa Thầy, chúng tôi biết Thầy nói và dạy cách ngay thẳng, và không nhìn mặt người ta, nhưng dạy đường lối của Đức Chúa Trời theo chân lý.
vi.B: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, chúng tôi biết những gì Thầy nói và dạy đều đúng. Thầy không thiên vị ai vì địa vị, nhưng dạy đường lối của Đức Chúa Trời theo đúng chân lý.
vi.R: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, chúng tôi biết mọi điều Thầy nói và dạy đều đúng. Thầy đối xử với mọi người như nhau, dù họ quan trọng hay không. Và Thầy dạy sự thật về cách Đức Chúa Trời muốn người ta sống.

decisions.choice: you do not receive a face: you show no favoritism
alternatives: you do not accept anyone's appearance at face value
decisions.reason: To "receive the face" was a Hebrew way of saying to favor someone because of who they are (Leviticus 19:15; Galatians 2:6). The spies say Jesus is not swayed by rank or power, so he will not fear the emperor.

decisions.choice: the way of God: the life God requires
decisions.reason: "Way" is often used for how one lives, and "the way of God" for the life he asks of his people (Acts 18:25-26).

decisions.choice: we know: flattery meant to trap him
decisions.reason: What they say is true, but they say it to lead him into an answer that will condemn him (20:20, 23).

decisions.choice: No one's rank sways you (B); You treat everyone the same, whether they are important or not (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:22
decisions.reason: The question itself comes in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: no recibes [el] rostro [de nadie]
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "receive a face", to show favor (meaning decision m1), as the English Literal does. The familiar church phrase is avoided; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: Maître (every level)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 19:39 and Mark 12:14: "Maître" is how French addresses a respected teacher. The same word is used for this address throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy" and "Thầy" for "you" in the questioners' words, with no deity_pronoun span; "chúng tôi" for themselves (also 20:28, 20:39)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:14 and 12:19: "Thầy" is a noun of address, always capitalised; the speakers keep their distance with "chúng tôi".

decisions.choice: "không nhìn mặt người ta" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom of receiving a face, as in Mark 12:14; Balanced and Readable say it means showing no favouritism.

source.text: ἔξεστιν ἡμᾶς Καίσαρι φόρον δοῦναι ἢ οὔ;

records.literal_gloss: Is it lawful for us to Caesar tribute to give or not?

en.L: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar, or not?"
en.B: Does the law allow us to pay tribute to Caesar, or not?"
en.R: Does God's law allow us to pay taxes to Caesar, the Roman emperor? Or should we refuse?"

es.L: ¿Nos es lícito dar tributo al César, o no?».
es.B: ¿Permite la ley que paguemos tributo al César, o no?».
es.R: ¿Permite la ley de Dios que paguemos impuestos al César, el emperador romano? ¿O debemos negarnos?».

fr.L: Nous est-il permis de donner l’impôt à César, ou non ? »
fr.B: La Loi nous permet-elle de payer l’impôt à César, ou non ? »
fr.R: Est-ce que la Loi de Dieu nous permet de payer des impôts à César, l’empereur romain ? Ou est-ce que nous devons refuser ? »

sw.L: Je, ni halali kwetu kumpa Kaisari kodi, au la?"
sw.B: Je, sheria inaturuhusu kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?"
sw.R: Je, sheria ya Mungu inaturuhusu kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, mtawala mkuu wa Roma? Au tukatae?"

vi.L: Chúng tôi có được phép nộp thuế cho Sê-sa hay không?"
vi.B: Luật pháp có cho phép chúng tôi nộp thuế cho Sê-sa hay không?"
vi.R: Luật của Đức Chúa Trời có cho phép chúng tôi nộp thuế cho Sê-sa, là hoàng đế La Mã, không? Hay chúng tôi nên từ chối?"

decisions.choice: tribute to Caesar: the tax paid to the Roman emperor by people under Roman rule
decisions.reason: Caesar was the title of the Roman emperor, at this time Tiberius (3:1). Since Judea came under a Roman governor in AD 6, its people paid a tax to Rome for each person. Judas the Galilean led a revolt against it (Acts 5:37), and many Jews hated it as a sign that a foreign ruler held God's land.

decisions.choice: lawful: allowed by the law of God
decisions.reason: The word is used for what God's law permits (6:2, 9; 14:3).

decisions.choice: the trap: either answer could ruin him
decisions.reason: If Jesus said "yes", he would lose the people, who hated the tax; if he said "no", he could be handed to the governor as a rebel (20:20; 23:2).

decisions.choice: the Roman emperor; Or should we refuse?
decisions.reason: Readable says who Caesar was (m1) and spells out the other choice.

decisions.choice: l’impôt (L, B); des impôts (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the tax paid by a subject people to Rome (m1). French "tribut" is now mostly figurative ("payer un lourd tribut"), so every level says "impôt", as in Mark 12:14. Balanced writes "la Loi": the law in question is God's (m2).

decisions.choice: "Sê-sa" at every level; Readable adds "hoàng đế La Mã"
decisions.reason: As in Luke 3:1 and Mark 12:14-17.

source.text: κατανοήσας δὲ αὐτῶν τὴν πανουργίαν εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς·

records.literal_gloss: Having perceived but of them the craftiness he said to them:

en.L: But perceiving their craftiness, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them,
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw through their trickery and said to them,
en.R: But Jesus knew that they were trying to trick {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He said to them,

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, percibiendo la astucia de ellos, les dijo:
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dio cuenta de su trampa y les dijo:
es.R: Pero Jesús sabía que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} querían engañar. Les dijo:

fr.L: Mais, percevant leur ruse, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit :
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit clair dans leur ruse et leur dit :
fr.R: Mais Jésus savait qu’ils essayaient de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} piéger. Il leur a dit :

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, akiutambua ujanja wao, akawaambia,
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliuona ujanja wao, akawaambia,
sw.R: Lakini Yesu alijua kwamba walikuwa wakijaribu kumdanganya. Akawaambia,

vi.L: Nhưng nhận biết sự xảo quyệt của họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ:
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy rõ mưu mẹo của họ và nói:
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu biết họ đang tìm cách gài bẫy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài nói với họ:

decisions.choice: he said to them: the reading of the SBLGNT, with no question following
alternatives: he said to them, Why are you testing me?, the reading of many manuscripts
the same with "hypocrites" added, the reading of some manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "Why are you testing me?", as in Matthew 22:18 and Mark 12:15. Several of the earliest manuscripts of Luke do not have it, and it may have come in from the other Gospels. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: craftiness: cunning, clever trickery
decisions.reason: The word is used of cunning that will stop at nothing (1 Corinthians 3:19; 2 Corinthians 4:2).

decisions.choice: they were trying to trick him
decisions.reason: Readable says what their craftiness was.

source.text: Δείξατέ μοι δηνάριον· τίνος ἔχει εἰκόνα καὶ ἐπιγραφήν;

records.literal_gloss: Show me a denarius; of whom has it image and inscription?

en.L: "Show {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?"
en.B: "Let {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} see a denarius. Whose likeness and whose inscription does it carry?"
en.R: "Show {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a Roman silver coin. Whose picture and name are stamped on it?"

es.L: «{{plural_you:Muéstrenme|Mostradme}} un denario. ¿De quién tiene la imagen y la inscripción?».
es.B: «{{plural_you:Déjenme|Dejadme}} ver un denario. ¿De quién es el rostro y de quién la inscripción que lleva?».
es.R: «{{plural_you:Muéstrenme|Mostradme}} una moneda romana de plata. ¿De quién son la cara y el nombre que tiene grabados?».

fr.L: « Montrez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un denier. De qui a-t-il l’image et l’inscription ? »
fr.B: « Faites-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} voir un denier. De qui porte-t-il le portrait et l’inscription ? »
fr.R: « Montrez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} une pièce d’argent romaine. De qui sont le portrait et le nom gravés dessus ? »

sw.L: "Nionyesheni dinari. Ina sura na maandishi ya nani?"
sw.B: "Hebu nione dinari. Ina sura ya nani, na maandishi ya nani?"
sw.R: "Nionyesheni sarafu ya fedha ya Kirumi. Picha na jina vilivyochapwa juu yake ni vya nani?"

vi.L: "Hãy cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xem một đơ-ni-ê. Nó có hình và dòng chữ của ai?"
vi.B: "Hãy cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xem {{units:một đồng bạc trị giá một ngày công|một đơ-ni-ê}}. Trên đó có hình và dòng chữ của ai?"
vi.R: "Hãy cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xem {{units:một đồng bạc La Mã|một đơ-ni-ê}}. Hình và tên của ai được khắc trên đó?"

decisions.choice: a denarius: a Roman silver coin, the usual pay for a day's work, used to pay the tax
decisions.reason: The denarius was the coin of the empire (7:41; 10:35). The coins of Tiberius carried his head and words calling him son of the god Augustus. Jesus does not take out a coin himself; the questioners have one ready.

decisions.choice: image and inscription: the portrait of the ruler and the words around it
decisions.reason: A coin bore the face and name of the ruler who issued it, a mark of his ownership and authority.

decisions.choice: image: perhaps a reminder that people bear the image of God
decisions.reason: The same word is used in the Greek of Genesis 1:26-27. If the coin belongs to the one whose image it bears, people, made in God's image, belong to God (20:25). Jesus does not spell this out.

decisions.choice: denarius (L, B); a Roman silver coin (R)
decisions.reason: As in 10:35. The coin itself is the point here, with its picture and name, so no level gives a modern sum of money; the meaning decision gives its worth.

decisions.choice: likeness; inscription (B); picture and name stamped on it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use words for what a coin shows.

decisions.choice: un denier (L, B); une pièce d’argent romaine (R), with no units setting
alternatives: a units setting with a modern sum, as in Mark 12:15
decisions.reason: As the English: the coin itself is the point here, with its portrait and name, so no level gives a modern sum; the meaning decision gives its worth.

decisions.choice: "một đơ-ni-ê" (L, and the alternative in B, R); its value or a description as the B, R default
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:15 and Matthew 22:19: the Vietnamese units setting gives a modern description by default and the Greek coin as the alternative; Literal keeps the coin.

source.text: ἀποκριθέντες δὲ εἶπαν· Καίσαρος.

records.literal_gloss: And they said, Caesar's.

en.L: And they said, "Caesar's."
en.B: They answered, "Caesar's."
en.R: They said, "Caesar's. The emperor's."

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «Del César».
es.B: Ellos respondieron: «Del César».
es.R: Ellos dijeron: «Del César. Del emperador».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « De César. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent : « De César. »
fr.R: Ils ont dit : « De César. De l’empereur. »

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Ya Kaisari."
sw.B: Wakajibu, "Ni ya Kaisari."
sw.R: Wakasema, "Vya Kaisari. Vya mtawala mkuu wa Roma."

vi.L: Và họ nói: "Của Sê-sa."
vi.B: Họ đáp: "Của Sê-sa."
vi.R: Họ nói: "Của Sê-sa, tức là của hoàng đế."

decisions.choice: Caesar's: the emperor's image and name
decisions.reason: The one-word answer refers to both the image and the inscription.

decisions.choice: The emperor's
decisions.reason: Readable reminds the reader who Caesar was.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Τοίνυν ἀπόδοτε τὰ Καίσαρος Καίσαρι καὶ τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: He then said to them, Therefore give back the things of Caesar to Caesar and the things of the God to the God.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Then give back the things of Caesar to Caesar, and the things of God to God."
en.B: He said to them, "Then pay back to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and to God what belongs to God."
en.R: Jesus told them, "Then give to Caesar what is owed to him, and give to God what is owed to God."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «Pues {{plural_you:devuelvan|devolved}} lo del César al César, y lo de Dios a Dios».
es.B: Él les dijo: «Entonces {{plural_you:devuelvan|devolved}} al César lo que le pertenece al César, y a Dios lo que le pertenece a Dios».
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Entonces {{plural_you:denle|dadle}} al César lo que se le debe a él, y {{plural_you:denle|dadle}} a Dios lo que se le debe a Dios».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Alors rendez à César les choses de César, et à Dieu les choses de Dieu. »
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Alors rendez à César ce qui appartient à César, et à Dieu ce qui appartient à Dieu. »
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Alors donnez à César ce que vous lui devez, et donnez à Dieu ce que vous devez à Dieu. »

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Basi mrudishieni Kaisari vitu vya Kaisari, na Mungu vitu vya Mungu."
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Basi mrudishieni Kaisari kilicho mali ya Kaisari, na Mungu kilicho mali ya Mungu."
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Basi mpeni Kaisari kile mnachopaswa kumpa, na mpeni Mungu kile mnachopaswa kumpa Mungu."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Vậy thì hãy trả lại cho Sê-sa các thứ của Sê-sa, và cho Đức Chúa Trời các thứ của Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Vậy thì hãy trả cho Sê-sa những gì thuộc về Sê-sa, và trả cho Đức Chúa Trời những gì thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu bảo họ: "Vậy hãy trả cho Sê-sa những gì các người nợ ông ấy, và trả cho Đức Chúa Trời những gì các người nợ Đức Chúa Trời."

decisions.choice: give back: pay what is owed
decisions.reason: The verb means to give back or pay a debt. They asked whether to "give" the tax (20:22); Jesus says to give it back, as something already owed.

decisions.choice: the things of God to God: God's claim comes first and covers everything
alternatives: two equal realms, the state's and God's
decisions.reason: The coin bears Caesar's image and may go back to him. But God's claim is on the whole person (10:27). Jesus neither refuses the tax nor gives Caesar what is God's.

decisions.choice: then: it follows from the coin
decisions.reason: The word draws the conclusion from what they have just said: the coin is Caesar's.

decisions.choice: devolver (L, B); dar (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "give back", pay what is owed (meaning decision m1), not the "give" of their question in verse 22. Literal and Balanced say "devolver"; Readable says "dar", as the English Readable says "give".

decisions.choice: kurudishia (L, B); kupa (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "give back", pay what is owed (meaning decision m1), not the "give" of their question in verse 22. Literal and Balanced say "mrudishieni"; Readable says "mpeni", as the English Readable says "give".

decisions.choice: "trả lại" (L); "trả" (B, R) for "give back"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:17.

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἐπιλαβέσθαι τοῦ ῥήματος ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ θαυμάσαντες ἐπὶ τῇ ἀποκρίσει αὐτοῦ ἐσίγησαν.

records.literal_gloss: And not they were able to catch of the word before the people, and having marveled at the answer of him they were silent.

en.L: And they were not able to catch {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] word before the people, and marveling at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} answer, they fell silent.
en.B: So with the people looking on, they found nothing in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words to seize on. His answer left them amazed, and they had nothing more to say.
en.R: So they could not catch Jesus saying anything wrong in front of the people. They were amazed at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} answer, and they kept quiet.

es.L: Y no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} pudieron atrapar en [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] palabra delante del pueblo, y, maravillados de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} respuesta, se callaron.
es.B: Así, con el pueblo mirando, no encontraron nada en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras de qué aferrarse. Su respuesta los dejó asombrados, y no tuvieron nada más que decir.
es.R: Así que no pudieron sorprender a Jesús diciendo nada indebido delante de la gente. Quedaron asombrados de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} respuesta, y se callaron.

fr.L: Et ils ne purent pas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prendre en défaut sur [{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}}] parole devant le peuple, et, étonnés de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} réponse, ils se turent.
fr.B: Ainsi, devant le peuple, ils ne trouvèrent rien à reprendre dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles. Sa réponse les laissa stupéfaits, et ils n’eurent plus rien à dire.
fr.R: Ils n’ont donc pas pu prendre Jésus en train de dire quelque chose de mal devant le peuple. Ils étaient étonnés par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} réponse, et ils sont restés silencieux.

sw.L: Na hawakuweza kulinasa neno [{{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}] mbele ya watu, nao, wakilistaajabia jibu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, wakanyamaza.
sw.B: Basi, watu wakiwa wanatazama, hawakupata chochote cha kushikilia katika maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Jibu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} liliwashangaza, wakakosa la kusema.
sw.R: Basi hawakuweza kumnasa Yesu akisema jambo baya mbele ya watu. Walishangazwa na jibu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, wakanyamaza.

vi.L: Và họ không thể bắt bẻ được lời nào [của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] trước mặt dân chúng; và vì kinh ngạc về câu trả lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ im lặng.
vi.B: Vậy trước mặt dân chúng, họ không bắt bẻ được lời nào của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ kinh ngạc về câu trả lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không còn gì để nói.
vi.R: Vậy trước mặt dân chúng, họ không bắt được Đức Giê-xu nói điều gì sai. Họ rất ngạc nhiên về câu trả lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và họ im lặng.

decisions.choice: before the people: in public
decisions.reason: They wanted a saying they could use against him in front of witnesses (20:20).

decisions.choice: marveling: amazed
decisions.reason: The verb is used for wonder at what Jesus says or does (4:22; 11:14). It does not mean they now believed him.

decisions.choice: with the people looking on, first
alternatives: before the people at the end
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the public setting first.

source.text: Προσελθόντες δέ τινες τῶν Σαδδουκαίων, οἱ ἀντιλέγοντες ἀνάστασιν μὴ εἶναι, ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Διδάσκαλε, Μωϋσῆς ἔγραψεν ἡμῖν, ἐάν τινος ἀδελφὸς ἀποθάνῃ ἔχων γυναῖκα, καὶ οὗτος ἄτεκνος ᾖ, ἵνα λάβῃ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαναστήσῃ σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Having come then some of the Sadducees, the [ones] denying a resurrection not to be, they asked him \v 28 saying, Teacher, Moses wrote to us, if of anyone a brother dies having a wife, and this one childless is, that should take the brother of him the wife and raise up seed to the brother of him.

en.L: Then some of the Sadducees came, those who deny that there is a resurrection, and they questioned {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 28 saying, "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
en.B: Then some Sadducees came up, men who say there is no resurrection, and put a question to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: \v 28 "Teacher, Moses gave us this law in writing: when someone's brother dies married but without children, the surviving brother is to marry the widow and raise children for the one who died.
en.R: Then some Sadducees came to Jesus. The Sadducees were a group who said that the dead will never come back to life. They asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 28 "Teacher, Moses wrote a law for us. It says that if a man dies and leaves a wife but no children, his brother must marry her. That way the dead man can still have children to carry on his family.

es.L: Entonces, acercándose algunos de los saduceos, los que niegan que haya resurrección, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron, \v 28 diciendo: «Maestro, Moisés nos escribió que si el hermano de alguien muere teniendo esposa, y este no tiene hijos, que su hermano tome la esposa y levante descendencia a su hermano.
es.B: Luego se acercaron unos saduceos, que dicen que no hay resurrección, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} plantearon una pregunta: \v 28 «Maestro, Moisés nos dejó escrita esta ley: si un hombre casado muere sin hijos, su hermano debe casarse con la viuda y darle hijos al que murió.
es.R: Después algunos saduceos fueron a ver a Jesús. Los saduceos eran un grupo que decía que los muertos nunca vuelven a la vida. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: \v 28 «Maestro, Moisés escribió una ley para nosotros. Dice que si un hombre muere y deja esposa pero no hijos, su hermano tiene que casarse con ella. Así el hombre que murió todavía puede tener hijos que continúen su familia.

fr.L: Alors quelques-uns des Sadducéens, ceux qui contestent qu’il y ait une résurrection, s’approchèrent et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogèrent, \v 28 disant : « Maître, Moïse nous a écrit que, si le frère de quelqu’un meurt en ayant une femme et qu’il soit sans enfant, son frère doit prendre la femme et susciter une descendance à son frère.
fr.B: Puis quelques Sadducéens s’approchèrent – ce sont des gens qui disent qu’il n’y a pas de résurrection – et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} posèrent une question : \v 28 « Maître, Moïse nous a donné cette règle par écrit : si un homme meurt marié mais sans enfants, son frère doit épouser la veuve et donner des enfants au défunt.
fr.R: Ensuite, des Sadducéens sont venus voir Jésus. Les Sadducéens étaient un groupe qui disait que les morts ne reviendront jamais à la vie. Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont demandé : \v 28 « Maître, Moïse a écrit une loi pour nous. Elle dit que si un homme meurt en laissant une femme mais pas d’enfants, son frère doit l’épouser. Ainsi, l’homme mort pourra quand même avoir des enfants pour continuer sa famille.

sw.L: Kisha baadhi ya Masadukayo, wale wanaokana kwamba kuna ufufuo, wakaja, wakamwuliza, \v 28 wakisema, "Mwalimu, Musa alituandikia kwamba, ndugu wa mtu akifa akiwa na mke, naye hana mtoto, ndugu yake amchukue mke huyo na kumwinulia ndugu yake uzao.
sw.B: Kisha baadhi ya Masadukayo, wanaosema kwamba hakuna ufufuo, walikuja, wakamwuliza swali: \v 28 "Mwalimu, Musa alituandikia sheria hii: mtu akifa akiwa ameoa lakini hana watoto, ndugu yake anapaswa kumwoa mjane huyo na kumzalia ndugu yake aliyekufa watoto.
sw.R: Kisha baadhi ya Masadukayo walimjia Yesu. Masadukayo walikuwa kundi la watu waliosema kwamba wafu hawatarudi kuwa hai kamwe. Wakamwuliza, \v 28 "Mwalimu, Musa alituandikia sheria. Inasema kwamba mtu akifa na kumwacha mke bila watoto, ndugu yake lazima amwoe mjane huyo. Kwa njia hiyo aliyekufa ataweza kupata watoto wa kuendeleza jamaa yake.

vi.L: Bấy giờ có mấy người Sa-đu-sê, là những người nói rằng không có sự sống lại, đến hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 28 rằng: "Thưa Thầy, Môi-se đã viết cho chúng tôi rằng nếu anh em của ai chết đi, có vợ, mà người ấy không có con, thì anh em người ấy phải lấy người vợ đó và sinh dòng dõi cho anh em mình.
vi.B: Rồi có mấy người Sa-đu-sê đến. Họ là những người cho rằng không có sự sống lại. Họ đặt câu hỏi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: \v 28 "Thưa Thầy, Môi-se đã viết luật này cho chúng tôi: nếu anh em của ai chết đi, có vợ mà không có con, thì người anh em ấy phải cưới người vợ góa và sinh con nối dõi cho người đã chết.
vi.R: Rồi có mấy người Sa-đu-sê đến gặp Đức Giê-xu. Người Sa-đu-sê là một nhóm nói rằng người chết sẽ không bao giờ sống lại. Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: \v 28 "Thưa Thầy, Môi-se đã viết cho chúng tôi một điều luật. Luật ấy nói rằng nếu một người đàn ông chết, để lại vợ mà không có con, thì anh em của người ấy phải cưới người vợ góa. Như vậy người đã chết vẫn có con nối dõi.

decisions.choice: Sadducees: a party of leading priestly families who denied that the dead will rise
alternatives: a group of teachers like the Pharisees
decisions.reason: This is their only appearance in Luke's Gospel. They held power in the temple and gave the five books of Moses the highest authority. They said there was no resurrection, angel or spirit (Acts 4:1-2; 23:8). So they quote Moses.

decisions.choice: Moses wrote: the law of marriage to a brother's widow, Deuteronomy 25:5-6
alternatives: a custom not found in the law
decisions.reason: If a man died without a son, his brother was to marry the widow, and the first son would carry on the dead man's name, so that it would not be wiped out of Israel (Deuteronomy 25:5-6; compare Genesis 38:8; Ruth 4:5, 10).

decisions.choice: raise up seed: father children
decisions.reason: "Seed" means descendants. The children would count as the dead brother's.

decisions.choice: resurrection: the raising of the dead to life at the end of the age
alternatives: life of the soul after death
decisions.reason: The word means rising up, and here the bodily raising of the dead (14:14; Acts 23:6-8).

decisions.choice: The Sadducees were a group who said that the dead will never come back to life
alternatives: Sadducees, who deny there is a resurrection
decisions.reason: Readable explains who the Sadducees were in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:33
alternatives: a new quotation in each sentence
decisions.reason: The Sadducees' case runs over several sentences.

decisions.choice: les Sadducéens
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form, capitalised like the other Jewish groups, as in Mark 12:18.

decisions.choice: "người Sa-đu-sê"; "sự sống lại"; "anh em" for "brother"
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 12:18-19 and Matthew 22:23-24.

source.text: ἑπτὰ οὖν ἀδελφοὶ ἦσαν· καὶ ὁ πρῶτος λαβὼν γυναῖκα ἀπέθανεν ἄτεκνος·

records.literal_gloss: Seven therefore brothers there were; and the first having taken a wife died childless;

en.L: Now there were seven brothers; and the first took a wife and died childless.
en.B: There were once seven brothers. The first married and died without having a child.
en.R: There were seven brothers. The first brother got married, but he died without having any children.

es.L: Había, pues, siete hermanos; y el primero, tomando esposa, murió sin hijos.
es.B: Había una vez siete hermanos. El primero se casó y murió sin tener hijos.
es.R: Había siete hermanos. El primero se casó, pero murió sin tener hijos.

fr.L: Il y avait donc sept frères ; et le premier, ayant pris une femme, est mort sans enfant ;
fr.B: Il y avait une fois sept frères. Le premier s’est marié et il est mort sans avoir d’enfant.
fr.R: Il y avait sept frères. Le premier s’est marié, mais il est mort sans avoir eu d’enfants.

sw.L: Basi palikuwa na ndugu saba; na wa kwanza, akiisha kuoa mke, akafa bila mtoto.
sw.B: Hapo zamani palikuwa na ndugu saba. Wa kwanza alioa, akafa bila kupata mtoto.
sw.R: Kulikuwa na ndugu saba. Ndugu wa kwanza alioa, lakini akafa bila kupata watoto.

vi.L: Vậy, có bảy anh em; người thứ nhất lấy vợ và chết không con.
vi.B: Có bảy anh em kia. Người đầu lấy vợ rồi chết mà không có con.
vi.R: Có bảy anh em trai. Người anh cả lấy vợ, nhưng chết mà không có con.

decisions.choice: there were seven brothers: a case told as if it happened
decisions.reason: The story is meant to show that belief in the resurrection leads to nonsense. A Jewish story of the time, in the book of Tobit, tells of a woman who lost seven husbands (Tobit 3:8).

decisions.choice: took a wife: married
alternatives: took a woman into his house as a servant
decisions.reason: The usual way of saying that a man married.

source.text: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν, ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ οὐ κατέλιπον τέκνα καὶ ἀπέθανον·

records.literal_gloss: and the second \v 31 and the third took her, likewise and also the seven not left children and died.

en.L: And the second, \v 31 and the third took her; and likewise also the seven left no children and died.
en.B: Then the second \v 31 and the third married her, and so on with all seven: each one died and left no children.
en.R: Then the second brother married her, \v 31 and then the third. In the same way, all seven brothers married her and died, and none of them had children.

es.L: Y el segundo, \v 31 y el tercero la tomó; y de igual manera también los siete no dejaron hijos y murieron.
es.B: Luego el segundo \v 31 y el tercero se casaron con ella, y así sucesivamente los siete: todos murieron sin dejar hijos.
es.R: Luego el segundo hermano se casó con ella, \v 31 y después el tercero. De la misma manera, los siete hermanos se casaron con ella y murieron, y ninguno tuvo hijos.

fr.L: et le deuxième, \v 31 et le troisième l’a prise ; et de même aussi les sept n’ont pas laissé d’enfants et sont morts.
fr.B: Puis le deuxième \v 31 et le troisième l’ont épousée, et ainsi de suite pour les sept : chacun est mort sans laisser d’enfants.
fr.R: Ensuite, le deuxième frère l’a épousée, \v 31 puis le troisième. De la même façon, les sept frères l’ont épousée et sont morts, et aucun d’eux n’a eu d’enfants.

sw.L: Na wa pili, \v 31 na wa tatu alimchukua; na vivyo hivyo wale saba pia hawakuacha watoto, wakafa.
sw.B: Kisha wa pili \v 31 na wa tatu wakamwoa, na ndivyo ilivyokuwa kwa wote saba: kila mmoja alikufa bila kuacha watoto.
sw.R: Kisha ndugu wa pili alimwoa, \v 31 na baadaye wa tatu. Vivyo hivyo ndugu wote saba walimwoa, wakafa, na hakuna hata mmoja aliyepata watoto.

vi.L: Và người thứ hai, \v 31 và người thứ ba lấy bà ấy; và cả bảy người cũng vậy, không để lại con cái và đều chết.
vi.B: Rồi người thứ hai \v 31 và người thứ ba cưới bà ấy, và cứ thế cả bảy người: ai cũng chết mà không để lại đứa con nào.
vi.R: Rồi người em thứ hai cưới bà ấy, \v 31 và sau đó là người em thứ ba. Cả bảy anh em đều lần lượt cưới bà ấy rồi chết, và không ai có con.

decisions.choice: and the second: the short reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: and the second took the wife, and he died childless, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts fill out the verse so that it repeats what happened to the first brother. Several early manuscripts have the short form, which leaves the verb to be supplied from 20:31. The sense is the same. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the seven: all seven brothers in turn
decisions.reason: The second and third married her, and so did the rest; the seven together left no children.

decisions.choice: and so on with all seven: each one (B); all seven brothers married her (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly that each brother married her in turn.

source.text: ὕστερον καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέθανεν.

records.literal_gloss: Lastly also the woman died.

en.L: Finally the woman also died.
en.B: Last of all, the woman died too.
en.R: At last the woman died too.

es.L: Por último murió también la mujer.
es.B: Por último, murió también la mujer.
es.R: Al final también murió la mujer.

fr.L: Enfin, la femme aussi est morte.
fr.B: Après eux tous, la femme est morte, elle aussi.
fr.R: Finalement, la femme est morte, elle aussi.

sw.L: Mwishowe yule mwanamke naye akafa.
sw.B: Mwisho wa yote, mwanamke huyo naye akafa.
sw.R: Mwishowe yule mwanamke pia akafa.

vi.L: Sau cùng người đàn bà cũng chết.
vi.B: Sau cùng, người đàn bà cũng chết.
vi.R: Cuối cùng người đàn bà ấy cũng chết.

decisions.choice: finally: last of all, after the seven
decisions.reason: The word means afterward, here at the end of the series.

source.text: ἡ γυνὴ οὖν ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τίνος αὐτῶν γίνεται γυνή;

records.literal_gloss: The woman therefore in the resurrection of which of them becomes wife?

en.L: So the woman, in the resurrection, whose wife of them does she become?
en.B: So when the dead rise, whose wife will she be?
en.R: So when God raises the dead to life, which brother will she be married to?

es.L: Entonces la mujer, en la resurrección, ¿de cuál de ellos llega a ser esposa?
es.B: Así que, cuando los muertos resuciten, ¿de quién será esposa?
es.R: Entonces, cuando Dios haga volver a la vida a los muertos, ¿con cuál de los hermanos estará casada?

fr.L: La femme, donc, à la résurrection, duquel d’entre eux devient-elle la femme ?
fr.B: Alors, quand les morts se relèveront, de qui sera-t-elle l’épouse ?
fr.R: Alors, quand Dieu fera revivre les morts, avec lequel des frères sera-t-elle mariée ?

sw.L: Basi yule mwanamke, katika ufufuo, anakuwa mke wa yupi kati yao?
sw.B: Basi wafu watakapofufuka, atakuwa mke wa nani?
sw.R: Basi Mungu atakapowafufua wafu, mwanamke huyu atakuwa mke wa ndugu yupi?

vi.L: Vậy trong sự sống lại, người đàn bà ấy sẽ là vợ của ai trong số họ?
vi.B: Vậy khi người chết sống lại, bà ấy sẽ là vợ của ai?
vi.R: Vậy khi Đức Chúa Trời làm cho người chết sống lại, bà ấy sẽ là vợ của người anh em nào?

decisions.choice: does she become: a present tense with a future sense
decisions.reason: The resurrection is still to come, so the question is about what will be.

decisions.choice: in the resurrection: they assume the life to come would be like this one
alternatives: they accept the resurrection for the sake of argument
decisions.reason: The Sadducees mean to show that the resurrection is absurd. Jesus answers that the life of the age to come is not like this life (20:35-36).

decisions.choice: when God raises the dead to life
decisions.reason: Readable says what the resurrection is.

en.L: For the seven had her as wife."
en.B: All seven of them had her as a wife."
en.R: All seven brothers were married to her!"

es.L: Porque los siete la tuvieron por esposa».
es.B: Los siete la tuvieron como esposa».
es.R: ¡Los siete hermanos estuvieron casados con ella!».

fr.L: Car les sept l’ont eue pour femme. »
fr.B: Tous les sept l’ont eue pour épouse. »
fr.R: Elle a été mariée avec les sept frères ! »

sw.L: Kwa maana wale saba walikuwa naye kama mke."
sw.B: Wote saba walimwoa."
sw.R: Ndugu wote saba walikuwa wamemwoa!"

vi.L: Vì cả bảy người đều đã lấy bà ấy làm vợ."
vi.B: Vì cả bảy người đều đã lấy bà làm vợ."
vi.R: Vì cả bảy anh em đều đã cưới bà ấy!"

decisions.choice: for: the reason the question has no answer
decisions.reason: Each brother has the same claim, so the case seems to have no answer.

decisions.choice: the quotation that opened at 20:28 closes here
decisions.reason: The Sadducees' question ends here.

source.text: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου γαμοῦσιν καὶ γαμίσκονται, οἱ δὲ καταξιωθέντες τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐκείνου τυχεῖν καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τῆς ἐκ νεκρῶν οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται·

records.literal_gloss: And said to them the Jesus, The sons of the age this marry and are given in marriage, \v 35 but the [ones] having been counted worthy that age to obtain and of the resurrection the [one] from dead neither marry nor are given in marriage;

en.L: And Jesus said to them, "The {{gender:children|sons}} of this age marry and are given in marriage, \v 35 but those who are counted worthy to attain to that age and to the resurrection from [the] dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
en.B: Jesus answered them, "In this age, men take wives and women are given to husbands. \v 35 But those who are judged worthy to have a share in the age to come and in the rising from the dead neither take wives nor are given to husbands.
en.R: Jesus said to them, "In this life, people get married. \v 35 But God will count some people worthy to live in the age that is coming. He will raise them from the dead. Those people will not get married.

es.L: Y Jesús les dijo: «Los hijos de esta era se casan y son dados en matrimonio, \v 35 pero los que son tenidos por dignos de alcanzar aquella era y la resurrección de entre [los] muertos ni se casan ni son dados en matrimonio.
es.B: Jesús les respondió: «En esta era, los hombres toman esposa y las mujeres son dadas en matrimonio. \v 35 Pero los que son juzgados dignos de tener parte en la era venidera y en la resurrección de entre los muertos, ni los hombres toman esposa ni las mujeres son dadas a un esposo.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «En esta vida la gente se casa. \v 35 Pero Dios considerará a algunos dignos de vivir en la era que viene. Él los resucitará. Esas personas no se casarán.

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de cet âge se marient et sont donnés en mariage, \v 35 mais ceux qui ont été jugés dignes d’avoir part à cet âge-là et à la résurrection d’entre les morts ne se marient pas et ne sont pas donnés en mariage.
fr.B: Jésus leur répondit : « Dans le monde présent, les hommes prennent femme et les femmes sont données à un mari. \v 35 Mais ceux qui sont jugés dignes d’avoir part au monde à venir et à la résurrection d’entre les morts ne prennent plus de femme, et les femmes n’y sont plus données à un mari.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Dans cette vie, les gens se marient. \v 35 Mais Dieu jugera certaines personnes dignes de vivre dans le monde qui vient. Il les fera revenir de la mort à la vie. Ces gens-là ne se marieront pas.

sw.L: Naye Yesu akawaambia, "Wana wa zama hizi huoa na huozwa, \v 35 lakini wale wanaohesabiwa kuwa wamestahili kuzipata zama zile na ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu hawaoi wala hawaozwi.
sw.B: Yesu akawajibu, "Katika zama hizi, wanaume huoa na wanawake huozwa kwa waume. \v 35 Lakini wale wanaohesabiwa kuwa wanastahili kushiriki zama zijazo na ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu, hawaoi wala hawaozwi.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Katika maisha haya watu huoa na kuolewa. \v 35 Lakini Mungu atawahesabu watu fulani kuwa wanastahili kuishi katika ulimwengu ujao. Atawafufua kutoka kwa wafu. Watu hao hawataoa wala kuolewa.

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Con cái của đời này cưới và được gả; \v 35 nhưng những người được kể là xứng đáng đạt đến đời ấy và sự sống lại từ [cõi] chết thì không cưới cũng không được gả.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu trả lời họ: "Ở đời này, đàn ông thì cưới vợ, đàn bà thì được gả chồng. \v 35 Nhưng những ai được xem là xứng đáng dự phần vào đời sau và sự sống lại từ cõi chết thì không cưới vợ cũng không gả chồng.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Trong đời này, người ta lấy vợ lấy chồng. \v 35 Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời sẽ xem một số người là xứng đáng được sống trong đời sắp đến. Ngài sẽ làm cho họ sống lại từ cõi chết. Những người ấy sẽ không lấy vợ lấy chồng nữa.

decisions.choice: the sons of this age: the people of this present life
decisions.reason: "Sons of" means those who belong to something, as in 16:8. Here it simply means people living in this age, before the resurrection.

decisions.choice: marry and are given in marriage: men take wives, and women are given by their families
decisions.reason: A man married; a woman was given in marriage by her father (17:27). Together the verbs cover all marrying.

decisions.choice: counted worthy: by God
decisions.reason: The passive verb means that God judges them worthy, as Jews often spoke of God's acts without naming him (21:36).

decisions.choice: that age and the resurrection from the dead: the life of the age to come, entered by being raised
alternatives: life in heaven right after death
decisions.reason: Jews spoke of this age and the age to come (18:30). Jesus speaks of the resurrection of those who belong to God, "the resurrection of the righteous" (14:14).

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The phrase means people of both sexes, as in 16:8.

decisions.choice: In this age, men take wives and women are given to husbands (B); In this life, people get married (R)
alternatives: The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the idiom's meaning (m1) and shows the two verbs (m2); Readable says it in the simplest way.

decisions.choice: God will count some people worthy; He will raise them from the dead
alternatives: those counted worthy ... and the resurrection from the dead
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who judges them worthy (m3) and makes the resurrection a separate sentence.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:38
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer runs over several sentences.

decisions.choice: hijos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "children" against "sons". Spanish "hijos" in the plural already includes daughters, as "hermanos" includes sisters, so there is no second wording for the setting to choose. The same in verse 36.

decisions.choice: esta era; aquella era (L); la era venidera (B); la era que viene (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is an age: this present life and the life of the age to come (meaning decisions m1, m4). "Siglo" is the older rendering but today means a century; "mundo" would lose the contrast of two ages.

decisions.choice: cet âge, cet âge-là (L); le monde présent, le monde à venir (B); cette vie, le monde qui vient (R)
decisions.reason: The word means an age of the world, this present life and the life to come (m1, m4). Literal keeps "âge", as the English "age"; "siècle" in this sense is old church language and now means a hundred years. Balanced and Readable use the usual French phrases for the two ages.

decisions.choice: zama hizi; zama zile (L); zama zijazo (B); ulimwengu ujao (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is an age: this present life and the life of the age to come (meaning decisions m1, m4). "Zama" keeps the two ages side by side; "kizazi" is a generation, and Readable says "ulimwengu ujao" (the world to come), as the shared term list has it.

decisions.choice: "Con cái của đời này" (L) with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con cái" is the Vietnamese word for children of either sex, as in Luke 6:35 and Matthew 5:9; the English gender setting has nothing to change here (also 20:36).

decisions.choice: "cưới ... được gả" (L); "cưới vợ ... gả chồng" (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:25: men marry and women are given in marriage (meaning decision).

source.text: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀποθανεῖν ἔτι δύνανται, ἰσάγγελοι γάρ εἰσιν καὶ υἱοί εἰσιν θεοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως υἱοὶ ὄντες.

records.literal_gloss: neither for to die any longer are they able, equal-to-angels for they are, and sons they are of God of the resurrection sons being.

en.L: For they cannot die anymore, for they are equal to angels, and they are {{gender:children|sons}} of God, being {{gender:children|sons}} of the resurrection.
en.B: They will never die again, for they are equal to the angels; and having had their share in the resurrection, they are {{gender:children|sons}} of God.
en.R: They cannot die anymore. In this way they are like the angels. They are God's {{gender:children|sons}}, because God has raised them to new life.

es.L: Porque ya no pueden morir, pues son iguales a los ángeles, y son hijos de Dios, siendo hijos de la resurrección.
es.B: Ya no pueden volver a morir, porque son iguales a los ángeles; y, puesto que han tenido parte en la resurrección, son hijos de Dios.
es.R: Ya no pueden morir. En eso son como los ángeles. Son hijos de Dios, porque Dios los ha resucitado a una vida nueva.

fr.L: Car ils ne peuvent plus mourir, car ils sont égaux aux anges, et ils sont {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu, étant {{gender:enfants|fils}} de la résurrection.
fr.B: Ils ne mourront plus jamais, car ils sont pareils aux anges ; et, ayant part à la résurrection, ils sont {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.
fr.R: Ils ne pourront plus mourir. Ainsi, ils seront comme les anges. Ils sont les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu, parce que Dieu les a fait revivre.

sw.L: Kwa maana hawawezi tena kufa, kwa kuwa wako sawa na malaika, nao ni wana wa Mungu, kwa kuwa ni wana wa ufufuo.
sw.B: Hawatakufa tena kamwe, kwa sababu wako sawa na malaika; na kwa kuwa wameshiriki ufufuo, wao ni watoto wa Mungu.
sw.R: Hawawezi kufa tena. Kwa njia hiyo wako kama malaika. Wao ni watoto wa Mungu, kwa sababu Mungu amewafufua kwenye uzima mpya.

vi.L: Vì họ không thể chết nữa, vì họ giống như các thiên sứ, và là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, vì là con cái của sự sống lại.
vi.B: Họ không thể chết nữa, vì họ giống như các thiên sứ. Họ là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, vì đã được dự phần vào sự sống lại.
vi.R: Họ không thể chết nữa. Như vậy họ giống như các thiên sứ. Họ là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho họ sống lại để có sự sống mới.

decisions.choice: equal to angels: like the angels in not dying
decisions.reason: The word is found only here in the Bible. People raised to life share the angels' deathless life; they do not become angels. The Sadducees also denied that angels exist (Acts 23:8).

decisions.choice: for: why there is no marrying
decisions.reason: Marriage in this life carries on families in the face of death (20:28). Those who can no longer die have no need of it.

decisions.choice: sons of God, being sons of the resurrection: God's children, because they share in the resurrection
decisions.reason: "Son of" means one who belongs to or shares in something (16:8). Those raised by God are his children (6:35; Romans 8:23).

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The phrase means men and women (m3).

decisions.choice: having had their share in the resurrection (B); because God has raised them to new life (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the second "sons of" phrase (m3).

decisions.choice: "con cái" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 20:34: the Vietnamese word already includes sons and daughters.

source.text: ὅτι δὲ ἐγείρονται οἱ νεκροὶ καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐμήνυσεν ἐπὶ τῆς βάτου, ὡς λέγει κύριον τὸν θεὸν Ἀβραὰμ καὶ θεὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ θεὸν Ἰακώβ·

records.literal_gloss: That but are raised the dead, even Moses showed at the bush, as he calls Lord the God of Abraham and God of Isaac and God of Jacob;

en.L: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed in [the passage about] the bush, when he calls [the] Lord 'the God of Abraham and [the] God of Isaac and [the] God of Jacob.'
en.B: And that the dead are raised, even Moses made plain in the account of the burning bush, where he calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob.'
en.R: Even Moses showed that the dead will rise. In the story of the bush that was on fire, Moses calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

es.L: Pero que los muertos son resucitados, también Moisés [lo] mostró en [el pasaje de] la zarza, cuando llama al Señor “el Dios de Abraham y [el] Dios de Isaac y [el] Dios de Jacob”.
es.B: Y que los muertos resucitan, hasta Moisés lo dejó claro en el relato de la zarza ardiente, donde llama al Señor “el Dios de Abraham, el Dios de Isaac y el Dios de Jacob”.
es.R: Hasta Moisés mostró que los muertos resucitarán. En la historia de la zarza que ardía, Moisés llama al Señor “el Dios de Abraham, el Dios de Isaac y el Dios de Jacob”.

fr.L: Mais que les morts sont relevés, Moïse aussi l’a montré au [passage du] buisson, quand il appelle le Seigneur “le Dieu d’Abraham et le Dieu d’Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob”.
fr.B: Et que les morts se relèvent, Moïse lui-même l’a fait comprendre dans le récit du buisson ardent, où il appelle le Seigneur “le Dieu d’Abraham, le Dieu d’Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob”.
fr.R: Même Moïse a montré que les morts reviendront à la vie. Dans l’histoire du buisson qui brûlait, Moïse appelle le Seigneur “le Dieu d’Abraham, le Dieu d’Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob”.

sw.L: Lakini kwamba wafu hufufuliwa, hata Musa alionyesha katika [habari ya] kichaka, anapomwita Bwana 'Mungu wa Ibrahimu na Mungu wa Isaka na Mungu wa Yakobo.'
sw.B: Na kwamba wafu hufufuliwa, hata Musa alilionyesha wazi katika habari ya kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto, pale anapomwita Bwana 'Mungu wa Ibrahimu, Mungu wa Isaka na Mungu wa Yakobo.'
sw.R: Hata Musa alionyesha kwamba wafu watafufuka. Katika habari ya kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto, Musa anamwita Bwana 'Mungu wa Ibrahimu, Mungu wa Isaka, na Mungu wa Yakobo.'

vi.L: Còn việc kẻ chết được sống lại, thì chính Môi-se cũng đã cho thấy ở [đoạn nói về] bụi gai, khi ông gọi Chúa là 'Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, và Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sác, và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.'
vi.B: Còn việc người chết được sống lại, thì chính Môi-se cũng đã cho thấy rõ trong đoạn nói về bụi gai cháy, khi ông gọi Chúa là 'Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sác và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.'
vi.R: Ngay cả Môi-se cũng cho thấy rằng người chết sẽ sống lại. Trong câu chuyện về bụi gai đang cháy, Môi-se gọi Chúa là 'Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sác và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.'

decisions.choice: the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob: Exodus 3:6, from the bush that burned but was not consumed
decisions.reason: At the bush God told Moses that he was the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob (Exodus 3:6, 15-16). There "Lord" stands for the divine name, YHWH. The Sadducees appealed to Moses (20:28); Jesus answers from Moses too.

decisions.choice: at the bush: in the passage about the bush
decisions.reason: Before the Scriptures had chapter numbers, a passage was named by its subject (Mark 12:26; Romans 11:2).

decisions.choice: showed: made known, pointed out
decisions.reason: The verb means to reveal or report something (John 11:57; Acts 23:30). Moses' words point to the truth Jesus draws out of them.

decisions.choice: he calls: Moses, in what he wrote
decisions.reason: In Exodus God says these words. Jesus speaks of them as what Moses says, since Moses wrote them down.

decisions.choice: the account of the burning bush (B); the story of the bush that was on fire (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that "the bush" means a passage of Scripture (m2) and which bush it was.

decisions.choice: the Lord
decisions.reason: The Greek has the ordinary word for Lord, so every level writes "Lord", and the meaning decision notes the divine name in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" with no divine-name setting; "bụi gai", "Y-sác", "Gia-cốp"
decisions.reason: The Greek has kyrios; the names and the bush as in Mark 12:26.

source.text: θεὸς δὲ οὐκ ἔστιν νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων, πάντες γὰρ αὐτῷ ζῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: God but not he is of dead but of living, all for to him live.

en.L: Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is not God of [the] dead but of [the] living, for all live to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: God is not a God of dead people but of living people, since all of them live in relation to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: God is not the God of people who are dead. He is the God of people who are alive. All of them are alive to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Ahora bien, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no es Dios de [los] muertos, sino de [los] vivos, porque todos viven para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.B: Dios no es Dios de muertos, sino de vivos, porque todos viven en relación con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.R: Dios no es el Dios de los que están muertos. Es el Dios de los que están vivos. Para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todos ellos están vivos».

fr.L: Or {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’est pas Dieu des morts, mais des vivants, car tous vivent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.B: Dieu n’est pas un Dieu de morts, mais de vivants, puisque tous sont vivants pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.R: Dieu n’est pas le Dieu des gens qui sont morts. Il est le Dieu des gens qui sont vivants. Pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, ils sont tous vivants. »

sw.L: Basi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa maana wote wanaishi kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.B: Mungu si Mungu wa watu waliokufa, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa wote wako hai mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.R: Mungu si Mungu wa watu waliokufa. Yeye ni Mungu wa watu walio hai. Mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} wote wako hai."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không phải là Đức Chúa Trời của người chết, mà của người sống, vì mọi người đều sống đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời không phải là Đức Chúa Trời của người chết, nhưng của người sống, vì đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả đều đang sống."
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời không phải là Đức Chúa Trời của những người đã chết. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của những người đang sống. Đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả những người ấy đều đang sống."

decisions.choice: not God of the dead but of the living: God's bond with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob outlasts death
alternatives: God has no concern for the dead
decisions.reason: God called himself their God long after they had died. He would not be God of people who no longer exist; they live to him, and he will raise them (13:28).

decisions.choice: all live to him: all who belong to him are alive in his sight
alternatives: all people owe their life to him
all will live for him in the future
decisions.reason: Death does not end their life toward God. A Jewish writing of the time says the same of the faithful martyrs, that they live to God (4 Maccabees 7:19; 16:25).

decisions.choice: God is not God of the dead: "God" is the predicate
alternatives: the God is not of the dead
decisions.reason: The noun without the article is what is said of him: he is not the God of the dead.

decisions.choice: Now he is not God of [the] dead
decisions.reason: Literal follows the Greek sentence, where "God" is what is said of the subject (m3); Balanced and Readable name God at the start.

decisions.choice: the quotation that opened at 20:34 closes here
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer ends here.

source.text: ἀποκριθέντες δέ τινες τῶν γραμματέων εἶπαν· Διδάσκαλε, καλῶς εἶπας·

records.literal_gloss: Answering then some of the scribes said, Teacher, well you said;

en.L: And some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken well."
en.B: Some of the scribes responded, "Teacher, that was a fine answer."
en.R: Some of the teachers of the law said, "Teacher, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave a good answer!"

es.L: Y respondiendo algunos de los escribas, dijeron: «Maestro, bien has dicho».
es.B: Algunos de los escribas respondieron: «Maestro, esa fue una buena respuesta».
es.R: Algunos de los maestros de la ley dijeron: «¡Maestro, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has respondido bien!».

fr.L: Et quelques-uns des scribes, prenant la parole, dirent : « Maître, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as bien parlé. »
fr.B: Quelques scribes répondirent : « Maître, c’est une belle réponse. »
fr.R: Quelques spécialistes de la Loi ont dit : « Maître, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné une bonne réponse ! »

sw.L: Na baadhi ya waandishi wakajibu, wakasema, "Mwalimu, umesema vema."
sw.B: Baadhi ya waandishi wakajibu, "Mwalimu, hilo ni jibu zuri."
sw.R: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema, "Mwalimu, umetoa jibu zuri!"

vi.L: Và mấy thầy thông giáo đáp lại rằng: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy đã nói hay lắm."
vi.B: Mấy thầy thông giáo lên tiếng: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy trả lời hay quá."
vi.R: Mấy thầy dạy luật nói: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy trả lời hay lắm!"

decisions.choice: some of the scribes: experts in the law who believed in the resurrection
decisions.reason: Many scribes belonged to the Pharisees, who believed the dead would rise and disagreed with the Sadducees (Acts 23:6-9). They approve of Jesus' answer.

decisions.choice: the teachers of the law
decisions.reason: As in 19:47: "scribes" today suggests people who copy documents, so Readable says what these men did.

source.text: οὐκέτι γὰρ ἐτόλμων ἐπερωτᾶν αὐτὸν οὐδέν.

records.literal_gloss: No longer for they dared to ask him anything.

en.L: For they no longer dared to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} anything.
en.B: From then on they did not dare put any more questions to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: After this, they were afraid to ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} any more questions.

es.L: Porque ya no se atrevían a preguntarle nada.
es.B: Desde entonces no se atrevieron a hacerle más preguntas.
es.R: Después de esto, tenían miedo de hacerle más preguntas.

fr.L: Car ils n’osaient plus {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interroger sur rien.
fr.B: Dès lors, ils n’osèrent plus {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} poser aucune question.
fr.R: Après cela, ils avaient peur de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} poser d’autres questions.

sw.L: Kwa maana hawakuthubutu tena kumwuliza neno lolote.
sw.B: Tangu hapo hawakuthubutu kumwuliza maswali zaidi.
sw.R: Baada ya hapo, waliogopa kumwuliza maswali mengine.

vi.L: Vì họ không còn dám hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì nữa.
vi.B: Từ đó, họ không dám hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì nữa.
vi.R: Sau việc ấy, họ không dám hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thêm câu nào nữa.

decisions.choice: for: the scribes' praise and the silence that follows go together
decisions.reason: Jesus' answers have ended the questioning. Luke's "for" links the scene's end with what came before.

decisions.choice: they: his questioners, all of them
decisions.reason: Chief priests, scribes, spies and Sadducees have all tried and failed (20:1-38).

source.text: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς· Πῶς λέγουσιν τὸν χριστὸν εἶναι Δαυὶδ υἱόν;

records.literal_gloss: He said then to them, How do they say the Christ to be David's son?

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "How do they say that the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} is David's son?
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "How can people say that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is the son of David?
en.R: Then Jesus asked them, "Why do people say that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is King David's descendant?

es.L: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¿Cómo dicen que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es hijo de David?
es.B: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¿Cómo puede decir la gente que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es hijo de David?
es.R: Luego Jesús les preguntó: «¿Por qué dice la gente que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es descendiente del rey David?

fr.L: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Comment dit-on que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est fils de David ?
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Comment peut-on dire que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est le fils de David ?
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus leur a demandé : « Pourquoi les gens disent-ils que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est un descendant du roi David ?

sw.L: Kisha akawaambia, "Wanasemaje kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni mwana wa Daudi?
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Watu wanawezaje kusema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni mwana wa Daudi?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, "Kwa nini watu husema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni mzao wa Mfalme Daudi?

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao người ta nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là con của Đa-vít?
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao người ta có thể nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là con Đa-vít?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu hỏi họ: "Tại sao người ta nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là con cháu của vua Đa-vít?

decisions.choice: the Christ: the Messiah, God's anointed king
decisions.reason: With the article it is the title of the king God promised to send (2:11, 26; 9:20).

decisions.choice: David's son: the king promised from David's line
decisions.reason: God promised David that a son of his would reign forever (2 Samuel 7:12-16; Isaiah 11:1). "Son of David" was a title for the Messiah (18:38-39), and Luke has shown that Jesus is of David's line (1:32; 2:4).

decisions.choice: they say: people in general, as the scribes taught
decisions.reason: Mark 12:35 names the scribes. Jesus speaks to those around him about what was commonly taught.

decisions.choice: How do they say: Jesus does not deny that the Christ is David's son
alternatives: Jesus rejects the Messiah's descent from David
decisions.reason: Luke has already called Jesus David's son (1:32). The question shows that the title does not say everything: the Christ is also David's Lord (20:44).

decisions.choice: King David's descendant
decisions.reason: Readable says what "son" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 20:44
decisions.reason: Jesus' question runs over three sentences.

decisions.choice: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}
decisions.reason: Here the word is a title, "the Christ", God's anointed king (meaning decision m1). Spanish keeps the article outside the span at every level, so the setting reads "el Cristo" or "el Mesías", where the English Balanced and Readable drop the article from "Christ".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} at every level
decisions.reason: The christos setting as the style guide gives it, as in Mark 12:35.

source.text: αὐτὸς γὰρ Δαυὶδ λέγει ἐν βίβλῳ ψαλμῶν· Εἶπεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

records.literal_gloss: Himself for David says in book of Psalms, Said Lord to the Lord of me, Sit at right of me \v 43 until I put the enemies of you a footstool of the feet of you.

en.L: For David himself says in [the] book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand \v 43 until I make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies a footstool for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet."'
en.B: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord: "Take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} seat at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand \v 43 until I put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet as a footstool."'
en.R: David himself wrote in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord God said to my Lord: "Sit here in the place of honor at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right side \v 43 until I defeat {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies and put them under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet."'

es.L: Porque David mismo dice en [el] libro de [los] Salmos: “Dijo [el] Señor a mi Señor: ‘Siéntate a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} derecha \v 43 hasta que ponga a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos [como] escabel de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies’”.
es.B: David mismo dice en el libro de los Salmos: “El Señor dijo a mi Señor: ‘Toma asiento a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} derecha \v 43 hasta que yo ponga a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos bajo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies como escabel’”.
es.R: David mismo escribió en el libro de los Salmos: “El Señor Dios le dijo a mi Señor: ‘Siéntate aquí, en el lugar de honor, a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} derecha, \v 43 hasta que yo derrote a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos y los ponga bajo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies’”.

fr.L: Car David lui-même dit dans le livre des Psaumes : “Le Seigneur a dit à mon Seigneur : ‹ Assieds-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite \v 43 jusqu’à ce que je fasse de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis un marchepied pour {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds. ›”
fr.B: David lui-même dit dans le livre des Psaumes : “Le Seigneur a dit à mon Seigneur : ‹ Prends place à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite \v 43 jusqu’à ce que je mette {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis sous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds, comme un marchepied. ›”
fr.R: David lui-même a écrit dans le livre des Psaumes : “Le Seigneur Dieu a dit à mon Seigneur : ‹ Assieds-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ici, à la place d’honneur, à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite, \v 43 jusqu’à ce que je batte {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis et que je les mette sous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds. ›”

sw.L: Kwa maana Daudi mwenyewe anasema katika kitabu cha Zaburi, 'Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu, "Keti upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \v 43 mpaka niwaweke adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuwa kiti cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."'
sw.B: Daudi mwenyewe anasema katika kitabu cha Zaburi, 'Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: "Kaa kitini upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \v 43 hadi nitakapowaweka adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kama kiti cha kuwekea miguu."'
sw.R: Daudi mwenyewe aliandika katika kitabu cha Zaburi, 'Bwana Mungu alimwambia Bwana wangu, "Keti hapa mahali pa heshima, upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \v 43 mpaka nitakapowashinda adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na kuwaweka chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."'

vi.L: Vì chính Đa-vít nói trong sách Thi Thiên: 'Chúa phán với Chúa của tôi: "Hãy ngồi bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \v 43 cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} làm bệ chân cho {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."'
vi.B: Chính Đa-vít nói trong sách Thi Thiên: 'Chúa phán với Chúa của tôi: "Hãy ngồi bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \v 43 cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} làm bệ chân."'
vi.R: Chính Đa-vít đã viết trong sách Thi Thiên: 'Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời phán với Chúa của tôi: "Hãy ngồi bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, ở chỗ danh dự, \v 43 cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh bại các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} và đặt chúng dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."'

decisions.choice: Psalm 110:1: God speaks to the one David calls his lord
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew of the psalm the first "Lord" is the divine name, YHWH, and the second is a word for lord or master, used of a king. David hears God speak to someone David himself calls lord. Peter uses the verse of Jesus' being raised to God's right hand (Acts 2:34-35).

decisions.choice: at my right hand: the place of highest honor, sharing the king's rule
alternatives: a place on one side only
decisions.reason: To sit at a king's right hand was to rule with him. Jesus will say that the Son of Man will sit at the right hand of God's power (22:69).

decisions.choice: a footstool for your feet: enemies fully defeated
decisions.reason: A conqueror might put his foot on the neck of a defeated king (Joshua 10:24).

decisions.choice: David says in the book of Psalms: the psalm is headed as David's
decisions.reason: Psalm 110 is titled "Of David", and Jesus' argument rests on David being the speaker. Luke names the book of Psalms again in Acts 1:20.

decisions.choice: the Lord God; in the place of honor; defeat your enemies and put them under your feet
alternatives: the Lord; at my right hand; make your enemies a footstool
decisions.reason: Readable shows which Lord is which (m1), what the right hand means (m2) and what the footstool pictures (m3), as at Acts 2:34-35.

decisions.choice: the psalm in single quotation marks, and God's words within it in double marks
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes David, and David quotes God, so there are three levels of speech.

decisions.choice: escabel
decisions.reason: The footstool is the picture of enemies fully defeated (meaning decision m3). "Escabel" is the plain word for a footstool; "estrado", the familiar church word, now usually means a raised platform.

decisions.choice: ‹ › for God's words inside the psalm, inside Jesus's words
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:36 and John 10:34: « » are Jesus's words, “ ” the psalm David speaks, and single guillemets ‹ › God's words within it, where the English uses single and double marks.

decisions.choice: Assieds-toi (L, R), with the deity_pronoun setting on "toi"
decisions.reason: French "s’asseoir" needs its reflexive pronoun, which the English "Sit" lacks; it refers to the Messiah, so it carries the setting like "your" in the same line, as in Mark 12:36.

decisions.choice: upande wa kulia wangu
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of "at the right (hand)", recorded once in this file: the plain word for the right side, the place of highest honor (meaning decision m2). "Mkono wa kuume" is older and less familiar to many readers.

decisions.choice: God says "{{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}" of himself and "{{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}" to David's Lord, with the deity_pronoun span; "phán" for God speaking; "Chúa ... Chúa của tôi" with no divine-name setting
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:36: the Greek has kyrios for both; "phán" is kept for God speaking (style guide).

decisions.reason: The name of the book in Vietnamese Bibles.

records.literal_gloss: David therefore him Lord calls, and how of him son is he?

en.L: So David calls {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} 'Lord'; and how is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} his son?"
en.B: So if David calls {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} 'Lord,' how can {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} be David's son?"
en.R: If David calls {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} 'my Lord,' then how can {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} be David's son?"

es.L: Así que David {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llama “Señor”; ¿y cómo es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} su hijo?».
es.B: Si David {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llama “Señor”, ¿cómo puede {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ser hijo de David?».
es.R: Si David {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llama “mi Señor”, entonces, ¿cómo puede {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ser hijo de David?».

fr.R: Si David {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelle “mon Seigneur”, alors comment peut-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} être le fils de David ? »

decisions.choice: how is he his son?: the Christ is more than David's son
alternatives: the Christ is not descended from David
decisions.reason: A father did not call his son "lord". If David calls the Christ his Lord, the Christ is greater than David. Luke has told how Jesus is both Son of David and Son of God (1:32-35); before the council Jesus will speak of sitting at God's right hand (22:69-70).

decisions.choice: him, he: the Christ
decisions.reason: The pronouns refer to the Christ of 20:41; "his" refers to David.

decisions.choice: David's son
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name David, since "his" could be misread.

decisions.choice: the quotation that opened at 20:41 closes here
decisions.reason: Jesus' question ends here.
